chapters.title: Detailing the superiority of Muhammad’s nation over other faith and deeds is a sign of his prophecy
paragraphs: [Chapter: The superiority of the nation of Muhammad over other faiths. And deeds are a sign of his prophecy]

Among the things by which he demonstrates the superiority of his nation over all nations - and this is necessary for his being a truthful messenger, as mentioned above, and it is a sign and proof of His prophecy, for everything binding is evidence of its binding.

Indeed, there are two types of nations: a type that has a book revealed from God, such as the Jews and Christians, and a type that has no book, such as India and Greece. And the Turks, and like the Arabs before the sending of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and there is no nation that does not need knowledge and work according to them, and it is carried out by them. Whatever serves the interests of their world, and this is among the general guidance that God has given to every human being, indeed to every living being, just as He guides an animal. To bring what benefits him through food and drink, and ward off what harms him through clothing and bedding, and God created in him a love for this and a hatred for this. God Almighty said:
{Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High, who created and made equal, and who ordained and guided} [Al-A’la: 1]

And Moses said: {Our Lord is the One who gave everything its creation and then guided it} [Taha: 50] And he said in the first thing that was revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {Read in the name of Your Lord is the One who created He created man from a clot of clots. Read. And your Lord is the Most Generous, Who taught by the Pen. He taught man what he did not know.} [Al-Alaq: 1] And the Almighty said: {Pain We will give him two eyes, a tongue, and two lips, and We will guide him to help.} [Al-Balad:

8], Then the nations differ in their knowledge of the Creator Almighty, and in their acknowledgment of the Day of Resurrection after death, either for the souls only, or For the bodies only, or for all of them, as is the saying of the Muslim ancestors of the nation, their imams, and their common people, Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama’ah. And they differ in what they praise and approve of in actions and attributes, and in what they disparage and deplore of that.

But the majority of the children of Adam are of the opinion that justice is better than injustice, honesty is better than lying, and knowledge is better than ignorance, for the one who does good to people Better than those who do not do good to them. As for the Day of Resurrection, it is either for the souls or for the bodies, and that people after death will be happy or miserable, and many people acknowledge this. Nations other than the People of the Book, even if it is in a limited way, such as the sages of India, Greece, the Magians, and others. That is because the people of the earth There are four sayings about the appointed time: one of them:

It is the doctrine of the Muslim ancestors, including the Companions, those who followed them in righteousness, the famous imams of Muslims, and other Sunnis. And the hadith from the jurists, the Sufis, and theorists, which proves the resurrection of all souls and bodies, and that when a person dies, His soul will be blessed, or tortured, then his soul will be returned to his body at the Great Resurrection, and for this reason God mentions in many of the surahs the commandment The two resurrections:

The minor resurrection is at death, and the major resurrection is when people rise from their graves and their souls are returned to their bodies, as God mentioned. The two resurrections in Surat Al-Waqi’ah, where he said at the beginning of it:

{When the event occurs, there is no one who caused it to be false, lowly, and uplifting. When the earth shakes with a turmoil and the mountains are covered with strength, then they are in vain. And you were three pairs. So the companions of the right hand, what are the companions of the right hand, and the companions of the place, what are the companions of the place, and the forerunners? Those are the close ones} [Al-Waqi’ah: 1]. Then, Glory be to Him, He mentioned the condition of the three categories in the Great Resurrection, and He said at the end of the Surah:

{Then, when it reaches the throat, you are then looking on, and We are nearer to it than you, but you do not see. Why not, if you are not You will return it to Medina, if you are truthful. But if he is among those brought near, then joy and comfort and a garden of bliss; and if he is among the companions of the oath, Then peace be upon you from the Companions of the Right. But if he is of the misguided deniers, then he descends from the boiling waters and the prayer of Hell.} [Al-Waqi’ah: 83] And likewise in Surat Resurrection:

{I do not swear by the Day of Resurrection, nor do I swear by the blameworthy soul. Does man think that We will gather his bones? Indeed, We will be able to level his buildings. Rather, man wants to make dawn before him, asking when the Day of Resurrection will be. When sight flashes and the moon eclipses and the sun and moon are combined, man says: On that day, where will there be escape? No, no, no burden belongs to your Lord. On that day, the established one. On that day, man will be informed of what has come before and what will come.} [Resurrection: 1] So he was reminded. The Great Resurrection, then he said at the end of the surah:

{No, when it reaches the joints, and it is said, “Who is separated” and thinks that it is the parting, and the leg turns to the leg to your Lord, that day will be the path.} [Resurrection: 26] And He spread out This is another topic, because the mention of the bliss and torment that the soul receives upon separation from the body is abundant in the prophetic texts.

As for the descriptions of the Great Resurrection in the Qur’an and Sunnah, they are very numerous, because Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, is the Seal of the Prophets, and he was sent among The hands of the hour, so he described the Resurrection in a way that no one else described it, just as Christ mentioned - describing him - and said: He will tell you everything He will come and make known to you all that is the Lord’s. And the second saying:

The saying of the one who confirms the resurrection of bodies only, as many of the Jahmite theologians and the Mu’tazilites, who were innovators from this, say. The nation, and some authors say this about the majority of Muslim speakers, or the majority of Muslims, and that is wrong, as it did not This is said by one of the imams of the Muslims, and it is not the saying of the majority of their theorists, but rather it is the saying of a group of their heretical theologians, who The predecessors and imams condemned them.

The third saying: The resurrection is for the soul that speaks of death only, and that bodies will not be returned. This was not said by any of the people of that religion, neither Muslims, nor Jews, nor Christians. Rather, they all agree on the restoration of bodies and on the Great Resurrection.

But whoever among these people philosophizes and his predecessors among the Sabians and the polytheist philosophers agreed that the Day of Resurrection is for the spirit alone, then he claims that The prophets addressed the public with the promise of eternal life, even though it had no reality, and they addressed them by proving the attributes of God, even though it had no reality. And that the prophets did not reveal the truths to creation,

And one cannot benefit from their news by knowing anything of the attributes of God, nor knowing anything of the Day of Resurrection. The truth of their saying that the prophets lied for the sake of gain, and that these are atheists and infidels among the Muslims who follow the prophets, And the Jews, and the Christians. Even if there are many of these people among those who pretend to be people of a sect, due to the appearance of their religions, while inwardly they are like this. Opinion.

And those who say about the resurrection of souls only, among them are those who say that souls are reincarnated either in the bodies of human beings, or in the bodies of Animals in general, or in the place of growing bodies, and among them are those who say that reincarnation is for wretched souls only, and many of their investigators He denies reincarnation

The fourth statement: Denying all enemies, as is the saying of the people of disbelief from the Arabs, Greece, India, Turks, and others. The philosophers who follow Aristotle, such as Al-Farabi and his followers, have three opinions regarding the resurrection of the souls: It was said: By the resurrection of the knowing soul. And the ignorant woman, and it was said: By the return of the knowledgeable woman, not the ignorant woman, and it was said:

By denying both, and Al-Farabi himself said the three statements, and extending the discussion to these matters has another place, as What is meant here is that everything that the People of the Book, and even the rest of the people of the Earth, have of beneficial knowledge and good deeds is with the Muslims. Muslims have something that others do not have in all the requirements by which happiness and salvation are attained. The wise men of all nations enjoin justice and good morals, and forbid injustice and immoral acts, and they have divine knowledge and worship. According to them, and they venerate the people of knowledge and religion among them.

India, Greece, and the Persians are more complete in this regard than the infidels of the Turks, the Berbers, and the like, even though these also have a share of That. It is known upon consideration that the nations who have a book, such as the Jews and Christians, are more perfect than the nations who have no book in virtues. Scientific and practical, for what people did not take from the prophets is learned by reason, consideration, or by dreams or inspiration. And news of the jinn and other such matters from the ways of the nations. And every correct path, whether rational, inspirational, or other paths, is shared.

People of the Book include those who do not have a Book. The People of the Book are distinguished by knowledge and deeds that they took from the prophets. It is not within the power of someone who is not a prophet to know them, and this is evident in Morals, domestic and civil policies. The people of the Book, even if they are abrogated and altered, are in better condition than those who have no Book.

As for acts of worship and belief in God and the Last Day, their success in it is clear, and as for sciences and deeds, their harm is likely. Such as magic, talismans, and what is used by means of polytheism to the use of devils, and the like. This, even if he is not the People of the Book. I do it, for that is only so that the People of the Book can suffice with what is most beneficial to them in this world and the Hereafter. For this reason, when God Almighty mentioned in the story of Solomon his innocence

That is, and the devils had written books of disbelief and sorcery, and buried them under the throne of Solomon. When he died, they revealed that and said: It was only He used to subjugate the jinn with these names and spells, and two groups believed them: a group who slandered Solomon, but rather disbelieved in him, from the People of the Book, and he said: who did That is why he is an infidel, and a group said: We imitate Solomon and do as he used to do, and they are the people of the conspiracies and talismans that They use the jinn with it, and they say: Solomon used to use it with them, to the point that they say:

These names were written on his crown, and this is an image of his signet ring, and these are the words of Asif bin Barkhiya, and other things like that. They add it to it, and it is a lie to Solomon. This was mentioned by Muslim scholars in the interpretation of the Almighty’s saying:

{And when there came to them a messenger from God, confirming what they had, a party of those who had been given the Book threw the Book of God behind their backs, as if they had no They knew and followed what the devils recited about the kingdom of Solomon, and Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved. They teach people magic and what was revealed to the two angels. In Babylon, Harut and Marut, and they did not teach anyone until they said, “We are only a test, so do not disbelieve.” Then they learned from them what by which they would separate between A man and his wife, and they are not harmed by anyone except by the permission of God, and they learn what harms them and does not benefit them, and they know to whom He purchased for him what he will have in the Hereafter, and evil is what they sold their souls for. If they had known, and if they had believed and feared, there would have been a reward from Him. With God is better, if they only knew} [Al-Baqarah:

101] Then Glory be to Him condemned those who turned away from following the Book of God and His Messengers, and followed what the devils recited during the covenant of Solomon, and Glory be to Him made clear that Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, and they were teaching people magic, and what was revealed to the two kings in Babylon, and that the two kings: Harut and Marut, They did not teach anyone until they had said, “We are only a test, so do not disbelieve.” And God Almighty told us that they would not harm anyone except with God’s permission.

And they learn what harms them and does not benefit them. Then He said: {And they knew that whoever buys it will have no share in the Hereafter} [Al-Baqarah: 102] that is, whoever buys it will have no share in the Hereafter. A share, that is, these people know that its owner has no share in the Hereafter, but they only ask that they fulfill their purposes with it. worldly things because of their desires in that, and that is harmful to them and not beneficial, as He said about the polytheist: {He prays for those whose harm is nearer than Its benefit} [Al-Hajj: 13] The Almighty said: {And if they had believed and feared, a reward from Allah would have been better, if they had only known} [Al-Baqarah:

103] So, Glory be to Him, has made it clear that through faith and piety one will attain the reward of God that is better for them than this, for they are only seeking it. Because of what they hope for is good for them, and this is good for them, and this is like His saying: {When the call is called to prayer on the day of Friday, then strive to Remember Allah and abandon trade; that is better for you.} [Al-Jumu’ah: 9]

For whatever souls seek in which they find pleasure is considered good in that regard, but if the pain exceeds the pleasure, its evil is greater. Of his goodness. The laws came to achieve and perfect interests, and to prevent and reduce evils. There is likely harm in it, such as jihad, and it is forbidden to do what is likely to cause harm, even if there is likely benefit in it, such as eating forbidden things. Alcohol and other things. For this reason, God Almighty commanded that we adopt the best of what has been sent down to us from our Lord. What is better is either obligatory or desirable. The Almighty said:

{So seize it firmly and command your people to take the best of it} [Al-A'raf: 145] And He said: {And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord} [Az-Zumar: 55] So He commanded to follow the best and adhere to it, and the Almighty said: {So give good news to My servants who listen to the word and follow the best of it. Those are the ones who May God guide them.} [Az-Zumar: 17] So he necessitated that others did not guide him, and this necessitates the obligation to adopt what is best, and this is a problem, and he spoke people in it, and its counterpart is the Almighty’s saying:

“And say to My servants, ‘Say that which is best. Indeed, Satan is dissuading them.’” [Al-Isra: 53], and the Almighty says: “Repel with that which is best.” bad deeds} [Al-Mu’minun: 96] with God Almighty saying in another place: {And they avert evil with good} [Al-Ra’ad: 22], and God Almighty said: {And argue with them. In a way that is best} [An-Nahl: 125], and He said: {And do not dispute with the People of the Book except in a way that is best} [Al-Ankabut: 46], and God Almighty says: And do not come near. The orphan's property is only with what is better in two situations.

It may be said: This is analogous to the Almighty’s saying: “So strive to the remembrance of God, and abandon sales. That is better for you.” And the Almighty’s saying: “Is God better or better?” What they associate with Him, and His Almighty says: By Allah, we are in clear error when We make you equal to the Lord of the worlds. And His Almighty says: And Allah is better and more lasting. And His saying: And the Hereafter is better and more lasting, and His saying: Then return it to God and the Messenger, if you believe in God and the Last Day. That is better. He interpreted it better and said, “Which of the two teams is better in standing and better as a rival?” And God Almighty said:

{And who is better in religion than he who submits his face to God, and is a doer of good, and follows the religion of Abraham, upright, and God took Abraham as a friend} [An-Nisa: 125]. And the Almighty said: {Be just; that is closer to piety} [Al-Ma’idah: 8], and His saying: {And if they had done what they are advised to do, it would have been better for them. And stronger in firmness} [An-Nisa: 66] There are many parallels to this, in which it is mentioned that what is commanded is better and better than what is forbidden, even if it is The first is obligatory and the second is forbidden.
This is because what is commanded may include a likely harm, and what is forbidden may include a likely benefit, so it is Considering that in

This is good and good, and there is evil and bad in this, but this is good and better, even if it is obligatory. The Almighty’s saying: {And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord} [Az-Zumar: 55] is a command to do what is better than doing or not doing what is commanded. The prohibited, which refers to the matter as obligatory and desirable, for both of them are better than the forbidden and the reprehensible. But the matter is an obligation and a matter that is desirable, just as He commanded good deeds in His Almighty saying: {And do good. Indeed, Allah loves those who do good.} [Al-Baqarah: 195] And doing good on his part is obligatory, and some of it is desirable.

chapters.title: Chapter on the mediation and moderation of Muslims in monotheism, acts of worship, and dealings
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Muslims’ moderation and moderation in monotheism, acts of worship, and dealings]

And if the race of the People of the Book is more perfect - in useful knowledge and good deeds - than those who do not have a Book, then it is known that the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace He, peace and blessings be upon him, is more perfect than the two groups of People of the Book: the Jews and Christians, and more just, and he has combined for them the virtues of what is in the Torah and what is in the Gospel. There is no scientific or practical virtue among the People of the Book, but the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is more perfect than them in it. As for the sciences:

They are more skilled - in all sciences - than all nations, even sciences that are neither prophetic nor eschatological, such as the science of medicine - for example - and arithmetic, And so on, they are more skilled in it than the two nations, and their writings in it are more complete than the writings of the two nations, in fact they are better in knowledge and explanation. It is among the first people for whom it was the goal of their knowledge, and the one who is skilled in it may be someone who is rejected by Muslims for hypocrisy and atheism, and no It was destined for him by them, but it happened to him because of what he knew of.

The Muslims are endowed with reason, and explanation is what has helped them to become proficient in these sciences, so the scum of the Muslims have become better at knowing and explaining these things. Sciences are among those who are advanced. As for the divine sciences and divine knowledge and what the prophets were informed of from the unseen, such as the throne, the angels, and the jinn, And Paradise, and Hell, and the details of the Resurrection. Everyone who looked at the words of the Muslims about it and the words of the Jewish scholars and the Christians found the words of the Muslims He completed it and completed it.

It is known that the knowledge of the People of the Book and the sect of this matter is more complete than the knowledge of others. As for worship, asceticism, morals, and politics Domestic and civil, speech in them is based on a principle, which is knowing what is meant by it, and how to achieve what is intended. So we say: People have schools of thought regarding the purpose of worship: some of them say:

It is intended to refine the morals of souls and modify them. So that she may prepare herself for knowledge, and it is not intended in itself, and they make it part of the category of morals, and this is the statement of a philosopher. Greece, and the saying of those who followed them from the atheists, Ismailis, and other Islamic philosophers

Such as Al-Farabi, Ibn Sina, and others, and anyone who followed their path, whether a theologian, a Sufi, or a jurist, as is found in the books of my father. Hamid, the murdered Suhrawardi, Ibn Rushd the grandson, Ibn Arabi, and Ibn Saba’in, but Abu Hamid differs in his words. Sometimes he agrees with them, and sometimes he disagrees with them. This fate was done by Ibn Sina and others like him, who sought to combine what the prophets brought with the Peripatetic philosophers - Aristotle. And others like him, and for this reason they spoke about the verses and the extraordinary things of customs, and they gave three reasons for them:

Astronomical forces, psychological forces, and natural forces; Since these were the influences in this world according to them, and they performed miracles for the prophets and non-prophets, And the miracles, and the wonders that magicians do are from the powers of the soul. But the difference between them is that this one intended good, and this one intended evil, and this doctrine is one of the most corrupt doctrines of rational people, as has been explained. We will talk about it in another place.

It is based on denying the angels and denying the jinn, and on the fact that God does not know the specifics, and does not create according to His will and ability. He is not able to change the world, and these people do not recognize miracles except what happened to this man.

The original, and this can be said about it, such as: rain falling, harnessing wild beasts, sickening others, killing them, and so on. As for turning a stick into a snake, reviving the dead, removing a camel from a plateau, splitting the moon, and the like, they do not acknowledge it. It has been known in various ways about the supernatural because of the actions of the jinn, and because of the actions of the angels. The conditions of the jinn are known to the common people:

Their Muslim and their disbeliever, no one denies that except he who is among the most ignorant of people, and likewise he who explains it by his own powers, and this is not narration. God is on their authority in what He sent down of the Book. As for the angels, their command is final, and they are God’s messengers in governing the world, as God Almighty said: {So those who administer a matter} [Al-Nazi’at: 5], and He said: {So the things that are divided are a matter} [Al-Dhariyat: 4] And God Almighty has mentioned in His Book some of their stories and their types.

What is long to describe, and whose effects are present in the world, this is known by consideration as it has been explained in its place; What is meant here is to mention people’s doctrines of worship, and these people are the ultimate goal of what they have in worship, morals, and wisdom. The process, because they saw the soul as having lust and anger in it in terms of practical power, and it had a view in terms of scientific power. They said: The perfection of desire lies in chastity, the perfection of anger in forbearance, the perfection of courage, and the perfection of theoretical power in knowledge. And mediating in all of this between excess and negligence is justice.

And what they mentioned of work related to recommendation, they did not confirm the characteristic of the soul, which is the love of God and His monotheism. Indeed, they did not know that as they did not They have only a little knowledge of God and a lot of falsehood, just as what was said about them was explained in its proper place. The love of God and His monotheism is the goal that is good for the soul, and it is the worship of God alone, without any partner. There is no goodness for the soul and no perfection for it except in that, and without that it is corrupt and has no goodness for it, as has been discussed previously.

In another place, and for this reason this was the religion of Islam upon which the messengers agreed, God Almighty said: {And We have certainly sent into every nation a messenger. “Worship God and avoid the tyrant” [An-Nahl: 36], and he said: “And We did not send before you any messenger except to him that We revealed to him, ‘There is no god but Me. So worship me} [Al-Anbiya: 25], and He said: {And whoever desires a religion other than Islam, it will never be accepted from him} [Al-Imran: 85], and God Almighty said: {And ask whom We have sent from Before you, among Our messengers, We made gods to be worshiped besides the Most Gracious.} [Al-Zukhruf: 45], and God Almighty said:

{O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness. Indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do. And this, your nation, is one nation, and I am your Lord, so fear Me. So they divided their affairs into divisions among themselves, each party rejoicing in what they had.} [Al-Mu’minun: 51], And He said when he mentioned the stories of the prophets: {Indeed, this is your nation. “One nation, and I am your Lord, so worship me and separate their affairs among them. All of them will return to Us” [Al-Anbiya’: 92], and the Almighty said: {He has prescribed for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah, and that which We have revealed to you, and that which We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “Uphold the religion and do not become divided in it.” [Al-Shura:

13], And the Almighty said: {So set your face upright toward religion, upright; the nature of God which He created mankind. There is no altering of God’s creation. That is the right religion, but Most people do not know who will turn to Him, but fear Him and establish prayer, and do not be of the polytheists, of those who divided their religion and became sects, every party They rejoice in what they have.” [Al-Rum: 30]

The Almighty said: {And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.} [Al-Dhariyat: 56] So the praiseworthy purpose by which the perfection of the children of Adam is achieved. Their happiness and salvation is the worship of God alone, which is the truth of the saying: There is no god but God, and for this reason God sent all the messengers, And He sent down all the Scriptures, and the soul cannot be reformed, purified, or complete except by this, as God Almighty said: {And woe to the polytheists who do not pay zakat} [Fussilat: 6] That is, they are not given what purifies their souls with it of monotheism and faith.

And everyone who does not attain this sincerity is not among the people of salvation and happiness, as God Almighty said: {Indeed, God does not forgive that any associate be associated with Him. And He forgives anything other than that to whomever He wills.} [An-Nisa: 48]

In two places in his book, and this is the first of the ten words that God sent down to Moses, where he said: I am God, there is no god but I am your God. Because I brought you out of the land of Egypt, from worship, you shall have no god but me. Do not take any pictures or images of anything that is in the heavens above, or anything that is in the earth below, or anything that is in the water under the earth. Do not prostrate to them; And do not worship them. Indeed, I am your Lord, the Mighty.

Christ, peace be upon him, testified that this is the greatest commandment in the law, as it is to worship God alone, without any partner, and to love God. To the servant than anything else, it is the greatest commandment and word that was brought by the messengers such as Moses, the Messiah, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers be upon them. All together, the opposite of this is polytheism, which God Almighty does not forgive: God Almighty said: {And among the people are those who take other than God as equals to them, whom they love. Like the love of God, and those who believe are more intense in their love for God.} [Al-Baqarah: 165]

This has been discussed in detail elsewhere, and it has been made clear that the soul has no salvation, happiness, or perfection except through God. Her idol and beloved, which is not more beloved to her than him, and for this reason there are many commands in the divine books to worship God alone, and the word Worship includes the perfection of humility with the perfection of love.

The worshiper must be a lover of the worshiped God with complete love, and he must be submissive to Him with complete humility. Whoever loves something and does not submit to it He does not worship Him, and whoever submits to Him and does not love Him does not worship Him, and the perfection of love and humility is only appropriate for God alone, for He is God. The one who deserves the worship that only he deserves, and that includes perfect love, humility, reverence, honor, and trust. And worship. Souls are in need of God in that He is their deity and the ultimate goal of their desire and desire, and in that He is their Lord and Creator.

So whoever believes in God, Lord and Creator of everything, and worships none but God alone, such that God is more beloved to him than everything else, and fears He is greater to Him than everything else, and greater to Him than everything else, and more important to Him than everything else. Rather, He is the one who has made God equal to one another. Creatures are in love such that they love Him as they love God, fear Him as they fear God, hope in Him as they hope in God, and call upon Him. As they call him, he is

A polytheist is polytheism that God does not forgive, even if he were chaste in his food and marriage, and were wise and courageous. What the philosophers have mentioned about practical wisdom is that there are no deeds that make souls happy or are saved from torment, just as what They mentioned that it is theoretical wisdom that does not include belief in God, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day, for they have no Knowledge is what souls are guided by, and morals are not true religion, and for this reason they were not included among the people mentioned in the Hereafter. In His Almighty saying:

{Indeed, those who believe, and those who are Jews, and the Christians, and the Sabians - whoever believes in God and the Last Day and does righteousness - they will have their reward with their Lord, and Fear is upon them, nor will they grieve.} [Al-Baqarah: 62] These four virtues that the philosophers mentioned are essential for the perfection of the soul. Its righteousness, and its purification. And the philosophers did not limit what is needed to a limit that shows the extent of what is achieved by it.

Survival and happiness. But the prophets made that clear, and He, Glory be to Him, said: {Say, “My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is latent, and sin. And oppression other than truth, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know.} [Al-A’raf: 33] These are The four types are the ones He absolutely forbade. He did not permit any of them to any of creation, under any circumstances, other than Blood, dead meat, pork, and other things, it is forbidden in one situation, and it is permissible in another situation. As for the four, they are absolutely forbidden.

Immoral acts are related to lust. Transgression without right is related to anger, and associating others with God is a corruption of the basis of justice, for polytheism is a great injustice, and speaking unjustly against God Knowledge is corruption in knowledge. God Almighty has forbidden these four, which are the corruption of desire, anger, the corruption of justice, and knowledge. And His saying: “And that you associate with Allah unless He has sent down no authority for it” [Al-A’raf: 33] includes the prohibition of the basic principle of injustice against Allah, and that is It necessitates the obligation of justice towards God Almighty, which is worshiping Him alone, without any partner.

The soul has two powers: scientific and practical, and human action is voluntary, and voluntary action is only done by the will of the servant. Every human being has a will, and acts according to his will, for man is sensitive and moves by will, and for this reason the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The truest of the names are Al-Harith and Hammam.” And the will must have a will, and every will is either intended for itself, or it is intended. For others, and what is intended for others must end in what is intended for itself.
Practical power requires that a person have a will, and that will for himself is an efficient cause of the efficient cause, and for this reason It was said: The common people say:

The value of every person is what he does well. Those who know them say: The value of every person is what he asks for. And in some of the earlier books: I do not look at the words of the wise man, but rather I look at his determination. These philosophers did not mention this in terms of the perfection of the soul, but rather they placed its practical perfection in modifying lust and anger with chastity. And dreaming, and this is its purpose, is to avoid excess in lust and anger, and lust: is to obtain what benefits the body and maintains its kind, and anger: Repel what harms the body. They were not exposed to the desires of the spirit that loves Him for His own sake.

Although they only spoke about what pertains to the body, and they made that a reform of the body, which is an instrument for the soul, and they made the perfection of the soul in Just science. We have explained their error in this principle in ways other than this, and we have shown that the soul has perfection in action and will. As it is for her

Perfection in knowledge, and that mere knowledge is neither perfection nor goodness for them, and if it were perfection, their knowledge would not be perfection. The soul, and we have shown the error of the Jahmiya who said: Faith is merely knowledge, and the correct statement is the saying of the Salaf and the Imams: Indeed, faith is a statement. And he worked. Its origin is the words of the heart, and the action of the heart that includes the knowledge of the heart and its will. If the soul must have an object that is beloved for itself, and it is not good without it, and it cannot be complete without it, and that is its god, then it does not have There is no god through whom there can be good except God, and for this reason God Almighty said:

{If there had been in them any gods other than Allah, they would have been corrupted} [Al-Anbiya’: 22], and that does not apply to man only, but also to the angels and jinn, for they are all alive. They are rational and articulate, they have knowledge and voluntary action, and there is no righteousness for them except by what they desire, the beloved for His own sake, and He is their deity, and it is not permissible for them to He is to be worshiped and beloved for himself except God. If there were in the heavens and the earth there was no god but God, they would have been corrupted. For this reason, the religion of all the messengers was to worship God alone, who has no partner.

These philosophers do not know that, for they do not have the self-righteousness and perfection of knowledge and work to escape misery. In addition to what you are happy with, and what makes this clear is that Aristotle, their first teacher, and his followers only proved the first cause of motion. astronomy, and they said:

Periodic movement is a voluntary, psychological movement, so its strength is due to its voluntary movement, its corruption is due to its absence, and the strength of its movement is due to He moves for the sake of it, for the agent’s choice is based on his final cause for which he moves, and his goal for which he moves Because of it, it is the first cause, so he moves to imitate it. So they established the foundation of the entire world by the first cause insofar as it is similar to it. Because the one who moves by his choice must have a goal.

It is known that a voluntary movement seeks a desired object for itself, and requires that that is greater than its obligation that is similar to it. Every person who moves with a will must have an object that is beloved to himself, for the will must have an object, and the object can be either desired. For himself, or for someone else, and what is meant by someone else is meant for that other instead of that other being intended for itself, or ending with What is intended for itself, otherwise a sequence in absent causes would be necessary, and that is invalid just like the invalidity of a sequence in clear effective causes.
Reason, and the agreement of wise people, and the explanation of this has another place.

And if the agent by choice requires a beloved will for himself, then it must be that which moves in the heavens by his will, whether it be These angels, or what they call them, are the soul of the Beloved, destined for Himself, who is the worshiped God intended for those movements. In the same way, the human soul is moved by will from its own needs, so it must have a Beloved and Desirer of Himself, and that is God. This Beloved that is intended for His own sake is God Almighty, and it is impossible for there to be anyone other than Him, as this has been explained in another place, and it has been made clear that It is impossible for it to exist by something other than Him, but rather it is necessary to exist by itself, so it is impossible for it to be intended for other than Him, but rather it is intended for itself.

Just as it is impossible for the world to have two powerful rulers, it is impossible for the world to have two worshiped gods, so the fact that one of them is powerful contradicts The other being capable; Because it is impossible for those who are capable of one thing to come together, and because one of them is unable to do an action when the other is capable of it, and because The ability of one of them increases with the ability of the other, with parity.

Likewise, it is impossible for two gods to be worshiped and beloved for their own sake. Because the fact that one of them is worshiped for its own sake contradicts the fact that the other is worshiped for its own sake, this necessitates that some Love and work for this, and some of that for this, and that contradicts the fact that all the love and work is for this, for company is a lack of love, so there is no The movement of the one who moves is due to his will, so neither of them is an object of worship to him unless the other is not like that, then the action is for this purpose. It is contradictory to have a partner, let alone having someone else.

And everyone who loves two things only loves them for a third other than them. Otherwise, it is impossible for each of them to be loved for its own sake. For what is beloved for its own sake is what the soul desires and seeks, and is reassured by, such that it has no desire other than Him, and this contradicts that He will have a partner.

The second saying: The saying of those who say: God compensated people by entrusting them with acts of worship in order to reward them for that after death. The enjoyment of reward is not good without the obligation; Because of the reverence it contains and the exaltation that only one who is accountable deserves, as the Qadariyya Muslims and others say, and these people have said They treat the legal duties as a kindness to the rational duties, and they may say: The intended goal by which the reward is obtained is Work, and knowledge is a means to it, until they say the same about knowing God Almighty, they say:
It is obligatory because it is a kindness in performing practical mental duties.

And the third saying: The saying of those who say: Rather, God commanded that, not for any desired wisdom or reason, but rather out of pure will, and this The Jabriya view that is opposed to Qadariyya is like Al-Jahm, Al-Ash’ari, and the likes of many theologians, jurists, Sufis, and others.
The fourth saying:

The saying of the nation’s predecessors and imams, which is that the very knowledge of God Almighty and His love is intended for its own sake, and that God, Glory be to Him He is beloved and deserving of worship for His own sake. There is no god but Him, and it is not permissible for anyone other than Him to be beloved and worshiped for His own sake, and He is Glory be to Him. He loves His servants who love Him, and is pleased with them, and rejoices in the repentance of the repentant, and He hates the unbelievers and abhors them, and is angry with them. And he disparages them, and that is one of the profound wisdoms in that, as well as among the reasons, which will be described at length in this speech, as has been explained in its location; The intention here is to point out that Muslims in this regard are more complete than others in useful sciences and good deeds.

If people’s doctrines are known regarding the purposes of worship, they also differ regarding their characteristics. Some people think that the more difficult it is for The soul and the more severe its killing of its desires is better, and this is the view of many

The Indian polytheists, and others, and many of the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, and many of the innovative Muslims. The second: The statement of those who say: The best of them is the one that leads to the achievement of the rational duties. The third: The statement of those who say: The superiority of some over others has no cause, but rather is due to pure will.

The fourth, which is the correct one, is that the best of them is that which is more obedient to God and more beneficial to the servant. The one who does it benefits more from it, and the one who does it is more obedient to God in it than anyone else, then it is better, as stated in the hadith: “The best deed is “The most beneficial.” And according to every saying, the worship of Muslims is more perfect than the worship of others. As for the first, they say: The more the deeds The harder it is on the soul, the better it is.

Then these people may prefer hunger, staying up late, silence, solitude, and the like, just as those of the polytheists do. India, and others, and from the Christians, and the innovators of this nation, but it is said to them: Jihad is greater hardship than

All of this, for it is humiliating oneself and exposing it to death. In it is the goal of asceticism, which includes abandoning the entire world, and in it is jihad against oneself. Inwardly, jihad against the enemy outwardly, and it is known that Muslims are greater in jihad than the Jews and Christians.

For the Jews disagreed with Moses in jihad and disobeyed him, and the Christians do not fight over a religion, and as for the words of those who make the legitimate acts of worship Be gentle with your rational obligations. There is no doubt that the Muslims’ acts of worship - such as their prayers, fasting, and Hajj - lead to justice, which is a common act. Rational duties, from the worship of others that they invented, include injustice that is contrary to justice. As for the statement that the explanation is negated, and that is attributed to the will of God:

So the matter in that matter is due to the pure will of God, and His worship of creation, and in that case, whoever’s worship is subordinate to God’s command Whoever the Messengers brought will be worshiped by what God has commanded, unlike those whose acts of worship were invented by their elders without him coming to them. It is the Messenger of God from God. As for the fourth saying: Knowing that God has commanded it includes obedience to God. This only applies to acts of worship that God has commanded, and they are the acts of worship of Muslims.

Except for those who innovated many of their major acts of worship. As for the benefit of the people from it, this is known by its fruits, results, and benefits, and this includes its effects on the good of hearts. Let a person consider the minds of Muslims, their morals, and their justice, and the difference between them and others will become clear to him.

Then the characteristics of their worship include perfection and moderation, such as purity, lining up, bowing, prostrating, and facing the house of Abraham. He who is the Imam of creation, and abstaining from speaking in it, and what is in it of humility, and the recitation of the Qur’an, and its listening, which shows the difference between it. And among other books for every fair thinker, as well as matters like that in which the superiority of the Muslims’ worship over the worship of Others. As for the ruling of Muslims regarding limits and rights, its virtue is not hidden from any rational person.

To the point that the Christians in a group of their countries appoint someone to judge between them according to the law of the Muslims if they do not have a law by which to rule. People. There is no general ruling in the Gospel, rather it is general, but it contains the command for asceticism and good morals, and it is what Muslims are commanded to do. Also. We have mentioned that Muslims are moderate and moderate among the Jews.

And the Christians in monotheism, prophecies, what is permissible and what is forbidden, and other things, which shows that they are better than the two nations, although the evidence These are very many, but the point is to draw attention to this, and in that case the virtue of a nation requires the virtue of its followers.

chapters.title: Separating the sections of the claimant of prophethood and the evidence of his truthfulness, peace be upon him
paragraphs: [Chapter: The sections of the one who claims prophethood and the evidence of that on his truthfulness, peace be upon him]

What clarifies the matter of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is that whoever calls for something like what he called for is not devoid of three categories: either he is a prophet, Truthful and sent from God as he told about himself, in the position of Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, David, Solomon, and others The prophets whom God mentioned in His Almighty saying:

{Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him, and We revealed to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob. And the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Yunus, and Aaron, and Solomon, and We gave David Psalms and messengers, whom We have related to you before, and messengers whom we had not We narrated them to you. And God spoke to Moses as messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people might not have any argument against God after the messengers. And God is Mighty. Wise, but God bears witness of what has been revealed to you. He sent it down with His knowledge, and the angels bear witness. And God is sufficient as a witness.} [An-Nisa:
163], or he was a just Muslim king who established a political law.

And a just law that benefits people and leads them to a just life according to the extent of his knowledge, just as the nations had someone who established for them Laws, such as the authors of the laws from Greece, India, Persians, and others. And if the one who gave the law was endowed with a sacred power by which he easily attained knowledge, and a psychological power by which he carried out actions outside of habit, and he has an imaginative power that represents to him within himself luminous forms and sounds that he hears within himself, for these The three properties are those that Ibn Sina and other philosophers like him say:

They are the characteristics of the Prophet, and whoever adheres to them is a prophet, and prophecy is acquired by them. But since this was the case for many people, and they did not reach the level of the truthful - the followers of the prophets - Like the Rightly Guided Caliphs, the disciples of Jesus, and the companions of Moses, We made it from this section; Since the person who does this may have justice and politics according to the knowledge and justice he has, so this is the second section. Either he is a lying, immoral, and sinful man who deliberately lies and is unjust, or he speaks without knowledge, thus making the mistake of someone who speaks without knowledge. Science.
And who believes that lies are truthful and falsehood is truth, and error is guidance, and error is

righteousness, injustice is justice, corruption is righteousness, and everyone who calls people to follow him and obey him is a matter of necessity and obligation, that they believe him. what he informed, and they obey him in what he commanded, and he made it obligatory, inwardly and outwardly, without giving anyone the choice to follow him, believe him, and obey him. It is permissible for him to disobey him in any way, whether inwardly or outwardly. He does not deviate from these three categories.

This is because either his intention was sin and aggression, or his intention was righteousness and justice. If his intention was the first, then he is unjust. An immoral person, and such a person can only be a liar intentionally or by mistake, and if his intention was righteousness and justice, then he is not Knowing all that He informs of of the unseen, being absolutely certain of the truth of Himself and not tolerating the opposite, knowing that what He commands is just and not permissible. For the one who ordered him to disobey him in some way, or not to be firm in that.

If he is certain of that, then this is the infallible Prophet who does not inform except with the truth, and does not command except with justice: {And the word of your Lord has been completed. Truthful and just. There is no altering His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing. So

This man may order things other than which there may be interests, justice, and honesty, and he may inform of things through his own ijtihad. It is possible that The matter would be otherwise, and he would inevitably make mistakes in some of the operations he told them and the operations he ordered them to do. No one is infallible except the prophets, and for this reason it is not necessary to believe in everything that people say. Unless he is a prophet, then faith is obligatory in everything that the prophet brings. God Almighty said:

{Say, “We believe in God and in what was revealed to us, and what was sent down to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and what was given to Moses and Jesus, and what The prophets have been given from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we submit.} [Al-Baqarah: 136], and the Almighty said: {It is not righteousness that you turn your faces away from The East and the West, but righteous is he who believes in God and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets} [Al-Baqarah: 177], and if the matter Likewise, it is known on the authority of the hadith that Muhammad mentioned that he was a messenger.

Like Abraham, Moses, and Jesus. Rather, he was told that he is the master of the children of Adam, and that Adam and those below him will be under his banner on the Day of Resurrection, and that when He was taken captive, and he came to his Lord. He exalted himself above all the prophets, above Abraham, Moses, Aaron, Yahya, Jesus, and others, and he informed That there will be no prophet after him, and that his nation will be the last of creation among the first on the Day of Resurrection, and that the Book that was revealed to him is the best. Hadith, and that he has mastery over the books before him, despite his belief in that, and then, if he knows the truth of himself, then he is a prophet. Messenger, and whoever says this saying knowing that he is a liar is one of the most unjust and most ungodly of people:

“And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about God or says, ‘It has been revealed to me,’ but nothing was revealed to him.” [Al-An’am: 93], even if he thinks he is telling the truth and is not. Likewise, he is mistaken, mistaken and ambiguous, and if that is the case then he must be wrong in what he informs of the unseen, and wrong in what he informs of the unseen. He commands it out of justice, and it is not imaginable that he will continue in this manner. Rather, it must become clear to him and to others that he is telling the truth or lying. Whoever thinks that he is telling the truth in such a claim is not being truthful.

He is one of the most ignorant and most unjust people, and he is the most distant from distinguishing between truth and falsehood, truth and lies, good and evil, for this In the same position as someone whom the truthful Prophet suspects of a false prophet, and this is one of the most ignorant people. If the condition of others is suspected, then what about the one whose own condition is suspected and who does not know whether what he is saying is true or a lie?

And who is ignorant regarding this great claim, the like of which no human being has claimed, and despite the abundance of what is reported about it from the unseen of the past? And the future, and He enjoins and forbids it in general matters, general Sunnahs, laws, and laws, so it must be in them. Of the misguidance and error that is made clear to most of creation. If his information about the past and the future confirm one another, and what he commands is the most upright path, and the book that came In it is a book that is similar and repeated, some of them similar to others in truthfulness. God Almighty said:
{Do they not contemplate the Qur’an? Had it been from other than God, they would have found in it much discrepancy.} [An-Nisa: 82]

For if it had come from other than God, there would have to be a contradiction in it, due to the inability of humans to convey this news. And therein are the unseen, and he gives these commands without contradiction, and for this reason there is no human being other than a prophet who is safe from that.

If Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, it was necessarily known from his biography that he was striving for honesty and justice, and that he was never tried to do so, It was absolutely a lie, and it was known that he was certain of what he told despite the greatness and abundance of the news, and he alone stood up and called the people to what he had come. With it, it is the custom of the one who seeks kingship and leadership - even if he is just - to seek the help of those who help him, such as his relatives, friends and the like, and to He gives souls what they desire, such as money and leadership, and intimidates those who disagree with him.

And Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, called the people alone while he was in Mecca, so the immigrants believed in him, then the Ansar believed in him in Medina, then they believed in him. The people of Bahrain, and he did not give any of them a dirham, nor did he have with him anything with which to frighten them, neither a sword nor anything else. Rather, he stayed in Mecca for some ten days. For a year, he and those who believe in him were weak. He had no money to give to them, nor a sword with which to frighten them.

The greatest of those who believed in him was Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, despite his perfect intellect and character, his religion among his people, their love for him, and the exaltation of his status among them. He spent all his money in the cause of God until the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: “What have you left for your family?” He said:

I left to them God and His Messenger.” The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not give him a single dirham of his own, then he took over the matter after him and left what He was with him for the Muslims, and Omar Ibn Al-Khattab took charge after him, and he conquered the greatest kingdoms in the world, the Kingdom of Persia, and the Romans, so he conquered the Romans in the lands of The Levant, the Peninsula, and Egypt. And his great leader, Abu Ubaidah, made people abstain from wealth, worshiped the Creator, was most merciful to creation, and kept them away from desires. The soul, and for this reason the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said about him: “Indeed, every nation has a trustee, and the trustee of this

The nation was Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah” and his commander in Persia was Saad bin Abi Waqqas, who answered the call and was one of the most ascetic people. He was the last remaining member of the Shura Council, and the people were disputing over the guardianship, and he was secluded in his palace in Al-Aqiq, not competing with anyone. So his son said to him: Omar: You left the people disputing over the kingdom and you sat here. He said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “Indeed, God loves the pious servant.” “The rich, pure and hidden.”

chapters.title: A chapter from the verses of prophecy, the story of the elephant and its guardianship of the sky
paragraphs: [Chapter: Among the signs of prophecy is the story of the elephant and its guardianship of the sky]

Among the signs of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the evidence of his prophecy that are in the Qur’an, is the story of the elephant. The Almighty said: {Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? Did He not cause their scheming to go astray - and did He send against them flocks of birds - pelting them with stones of clay - so He made them like edible chaff.} [Al-Fil:

1 - 5], and the story of the owners of the elephant has been repeated, and that the Christian people of 72 Abyssinia marched with a great army, with an elephant, to destroy The Kaaba When some Arabs insulted their church in Yemen, they intended to insult the Kaaba and glorify their churches, so God sent a bird against them. He destroyed them, and that was the year of the birth of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the neighbors of the house were polytheists who worshiped idols, and the religion of the Christians Better than their religion.

Thus it was known that this verse was not for the sake of the neighbors of the house at that time, but rather it was for the sake of the house or for the sake of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. And the greeting, which he was born in that year at home, or a combination of both, and whichever it is is one of the signs of his prophecy. If it is said: It was only a sign for the House, a preservation of it, and a defense of it; Because it is the house of God that Abraham the friend built.

It has been known that none of the people of that religion will make the pilgrimage to this house and pray to it except the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and Muhammad is the Who made his Hajj and prayers obligatory, then this house is better in the eyes of God than the churches of the Christians. Indeed, God destroyed the Christians. When the people of the churches wanted to glorify the churches and insult the House, it was known that the religion of the people of this House is better than the religion of the Christians and the polytheists. They are not better than the Christians, so it is evident that the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is better than the Christians, and that requires that their prophet is truthful, otherwise Those who follow a false prophet are not better than Christians, but rather they are the worst of creation, like the followers of Musaylimah the liar, and Al-Aswad Al-'Ansi, And others, and he said in the Qur’an:
{Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the companions of the Elephant - Did He not cause their scheming to go astray - and sent upon them flocks of birds?} [Al-Fil: 1-3]

And the Ababils are in groups dispersed, one group after another. {You throw stones at them from shale} [Al-Fil: 4] meaning: from concretized clay. {So He made them Like hay that has been eaten.} [Al-Fil: 5] Like hay that has been eaten. And his saying: Didn’t you see there is a question about the meaning of the report? This implies that this happened and the people knew about it and saw it, and they decided on it. That; Because of its significance, clarification, and blessings to creation. Among his clear signs that are in the Qur’an is what he mentioned about the sky being filled with a strong guard and meteors, contrary to what was usual with him. God Almighty said:

{Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, “Indeed, we have heard a wondrous Qur’an - it guides to right path.” So we believed in it, and we will not associate with our Lord anyone.} [Jinn: 1 - 2]

To his saying: {And when we touched the sky, we found it filled with a strong guard and shooting stars - and we were sitting in it on seats to listen. He listens now and finds a meteor watching over him - and we do not know whether evil was intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intended for them guidance} [Al-Jinn: 8-10], and he said God Almighty: {And what the devils have sent down - and it is not for them, nor are they able - indeed they are isolated from hearing.} [Al-Shu’ara’:

210 - 212] This was the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, reciting it to the people, and they recited it, and no one denied it, and no believer doubted it, and no An unbeliever argued this against him, and it indicated that the people knew the truth of what the jinn had told him, that the sky was filled with strong guards and meteors, and that they did not They are then able to listen to what they were able to do before.

It is known that this is something that people see with their eyes, because the sky being filled with meteors is something that all people see. If it were not so, The people would deny this, their believers and their disbelievers, for the great group who did not collude would be impossible to agree on. Lying, believing what they know is a lie, concealing what they know, and refraining from denying what they know is a lie.

The Qur’an was heard by thousands of people who understood its message and witnessed the conditions of the heavens. If this had not been the case, it would have existed - even though the majority of them were denying him, and when they believed they were different sects - it is impossible for them to agree on a lie, concealment, or silence, since no one denied it, rather The news appeared to be similar to what the Qur’an told of regarding the great shooting of meteors, the likes of which had never been known, to the point that they began to doubt: Did Is that regarding the planets in the orbit or elsewhere? And they said:

If it is among the stars of the spheres, then it is the ruin of the world, but when they narrated it in what is below them, they knew that it was because of something that had happened. In the two Sahihs of the hadith of Ibn Abbas, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, set out with a group of his companions, heading to the market of Ukaz. There was an obstacle between the devils and the news of heaven, and meteors were sent upon them, so the devils returned to their people, and they said: What is the matter with you? They said: There is a barrier between us and the sky. Meteors were sent upon us. They said:
This is nothing but something that happened, so strike the easts and wests of the earth and see what is this that has come between us and the news of heaven? So they went off to strike

From the east and west of the land, the group who had been taken passed by towards Tihama, which is in Nakhl, heading to the market of Ukaz, and he was with his companions in prayer. Fajr prayer. When they heard the Qur’an, they listened to it and said: This is what has come between us and the news of heaven. So they returned to their people and said: Oh. Our people: {Indeed, we have heard a wondrous Qur’an - it guides to right path, so we believe in it, and we will not associate anyone with our Lord} [Al-Jinn: 1-2]. Then God Almighty revealed to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened} [The jinn:
1] », and in Al-Bukhari’s wording, “a palm tree near Mecca”, which is correct.

Some people thought that meteors were not targeted at in any way before that, but what is correct is that they were sometimes thrown at - as is the case now. As was proven in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, and it was also narrated by Ahmad in his Musnad that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, “while he was with a group of One of the Ansar was when a star was shot and it became illuminated. He said to them: What did you say about this star that was shot at in the pre-Islamic era? They said: When we saw it being thrown, we used to say: A king has died. A baby boy was born, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said:

This is not the case, but when God decrees a matter regarding His creation, the people of the Throne hear it and praise Him, and those under them praise Him with their praise. Then those below that would glorify God, and the glorification continued to descend until it reached the lowest heaven, until some of them said to one another: Why did you glorify God? They say: Those above us glorified God, and we glorified them with their glorifications. They say: Don’t you ask those above you why they glorified them? So they ask them and they say:

God decreed such-and-such regarding His creation, the matter that happened, and the news about it descends from heaven to heaven until it reaches the heaven of the world. So they would talk about it, and the devils would steal it by hearing, based on delusion and disagreement on their part, then they would bring it to soothsayers from the people of the earth. They would talk to them and they would make mistakes and get it right, so the soothsayers would talk.” And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Aisha, she said: I said: O Messenger of God, “Indeed

The soothsayers used to tell us something and it was true. He said: That word of truth is snatched by the genie and thrown into the ear of his guardian. It contains more than a hundred lies.” Al-Bukhari narrated in his Sahih on the authority of Aisha that she heard the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, say: “The angels descend in the sky, which is the clouds, and the matter is remembered and decided in the sky. Then the devils eavesdrop and hear it and reveal it to the soothsayers. Then they will tell a hundred lies along with it from within themselves.” And in Sahih Al-Bukhari also on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said:
“The Prophet of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: When God has decided the matter in heaven, the angels will beat their wings in submission to His saying: As if it were a chain on

Safwan, and when it departs from their hearts, they say: What did your Lord say? They said to the one who said: “The truth, and He is the Most High, the Great” [Saba: 23] Then those who eavesdrop will hear it, and those who eavesdrop will hear it like this, one above the other. So he hears the word and delivers it on the tongue of the magician or soothsayer. Perhaps the shooting star overtook him before he delivered it, and perhaps he delivered it before he He overtakes him and tells a hundred lies along with it, and it is said: Didn’t he say to us on such-and-such a day: such-and-such? The word that was heard from heaven, so that word that was heard from heaven is believed.”

It was narrated by Muhammad bin Ishaq, on the authority of Al-Zuhri, and he said at the end: “Then God Almighty blocked the devils from hearing about these stars. Then the soothsaying ceased, so there is no soothsaying.” It was narrated by Muammar, on the authority of Al-Zuhri, and he said: So I said to Al-Zuhri: Was it used to be thrown at in pre-Islamic times? He said: Yes, I said: God says {And we used to sit therein as seats for listening} [Al-Jinn: 9] the verse. He said: She became harsh and her situation became severe when the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent.

Al-Tabari narrated, on the authority of Dawud, on the authority of Asim bin Ali bin Asim, on the authority of Ata’ bin Al-Sa’ib, on the authority of Sa’id bin Jubayr, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: It was The jinn have seats in the heavens, listening to the revelation, and when the revelation was revealed, the angels heard the shape of a piece of iron being thrown on the fine surface. So when the angels heard the call of revelation, the angels in heaven would fall on their foreheads, and when the companions of revelation descended upon them, they would say: What did your Lord say? He said: Then they will be called: Your Lord has said: {The Truth, and He is the Most High, the Great} [Saba: 23] He said: When He descends to the lowest heaven, they say:

There will be such-and-such death in the earth, such-and-such life, such-and-such drought, such-and-such fertility, and what he wants to do, And He did not want to begin - Blessed and Most High - then the jinn descended and revealed to their guardians from mankind what would happen on earth, so while they were Likewise, when the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent, and the devils were rebuked, and they pelted them with the stars, but they were prevented, so it was made that no one would ascend except It burned, and the people of the earth were terrified by what they saw in the stars, and this had not happened before that, so they said:

Whoever was in heaven perished, and the people of Taif were the first to be terrified, so the man went to his camels and slaughtered a camel for their gods every day. Then the owner of the sheep will go and slaughter a sheep every day. Then the owner of the herds will go and slaughter a cow every day. Then a man said to them: Woe to you. Do not waste your wealth, for your wealth is among the

Of the stars by which you are guided, nothing has fallen from them. So they took off and had hastened with their money, and Iblis said: An event has happened on earth, so bring me soil from every place on earth, so he made no The soil of the land is brought unless he smells it. When he was brought to the soil of Tihama, he said: Here the event happened. So God sent a group of the jinn to him while he was reciting the Qur’an, and they said: {Indeed, we have heard a wondrous Qur’an} [Al-Jinn: 1] until He concluded the verse, so they turned:

To their people as warners. It was narrated by Abu Zur’ah, on the authority of Musa bin Ismail, on the authority of Hammad bin Salamah, on the authority of Ata’ and similar to it, and it was narrated by Al-Bayhaqi. From different ways, on the authority of Hammad bin Salamah, also on the authority of Ata’, it has become clear that when he was sent, the sky was filled with intense guards and meteors. Before that, the guard was not strong, nor was the sky filled with guards and meteors - as it is now - which are sometimes shot, and they would sit back. It has seats for listening, that is, someone can eavesdrop on what he hears just as a listener listens to someone else’s conversation, concealing his listening, eavesdropping on it. The devils were eavesdropping - that is, listening - to what the angels were saying. When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent, one of them became, when he heard, he would find The shooting star had been spotted for him, so he was unable to sit and listen as he had done before.

chapters.title: A chapter of the verses of prophecy that have been proven by the Qur’an or by transmission
paragraphs: [Chapter: Among the signs of prophecy are those proven by the Qur’an or by transmission]

We have mentioned some of its verses in the Qur’an. Because among the People of the Book are those who say: We do not believe except in what is in the Qur’an as in the Torah, and the Gospel from the signs of Moses, and Christ, since he was conveyed The Qur’an has been repeatedly narrated and no one has any doubts about it, so he alerted us to some of what is in the Qur’an, even though its verses that are not in the Qur’an are very many.

It is not a condition for a mutawatir narration to be in the Qur’an. Rather, it is also transmitted from it in its law that which is not in the Qur’an, and it is part of the wisdom that God revealed it to him as well, and evidence of his prophecy was transmitted from him that is not in the Qur’an, but it is among its proofs and verses, and God Almighty said: In other places: {And God has sent down to you the Book and the wisdom} [An-Nisa: 113] So the wisdom was revealed to him, and it was transferred in something other than the Qur’an. It was reported that the prayers were five, and the dawn prayers were two rak'ahs.

The Maghrib prayer is three rak’ahs, and the remaining four rak’ahs, and the four rak’ahs in travel are two rak’ahs. There are so many types of miracles and frequent reports regarding the various types of His verses and proofs that it is impossible to count them. They are It includes both types of knowledge, and the ability to inform people of the future unseen in detail, as if he had seen them with his own eyes. News comes from it only as it was reported, and this is something that would never happen except to a prophet.

As for the soothsayer, astrologer, and the like, they lie a lot, and they sometimes tell the truth, and they tell in incomplete sentences. As for the people of guardianship and righteousness, the most revealing of them is the one who tells about that a few things that do not amount to a tenth of what he tells. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they do not tell them in detail like his story, and with different types of power and extraordinary behavior, and the verses are either As a matter of knowledge, information, and disclosure, or as a matter of power, influence, or control.

There is much information about the future in the Qur’an, such as the Almighty’s saying: {Have you defeated the Romans - in the nearest part of the earth, and they are after their defeat? They will be victorious - in a few years - to Allah belongs the matter before.} [Al-Rum: 1 - 4] And after that, the Romans defeated Persia in a few years, and we have mentioned in detail That is in the past, and as the Almighty says: {Allah has promised those of you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will certainly appoint them as successors in the land, just as He appointed those before them, and to establish for them their religion which He has chosen for them, and to replace them with security after their fear.} [An-Nur: 55], and it was as he had been told.
Al-Darimi narrated,

On the authority of Ubayy ibn Ka’b, who said: “When the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and his companions came to Medina and the Ansar took shelter in them, the Arabs threw them away. One bow, and they would not spend the night unless armed, and would not go out in the morning without it, so they said: You see that we will live until we sleep at peace, fearing nothing but God Almighty, so the verse was revealed: “God has promised those who believe among you and do righteous deeds” [Al-Nour: 55] until the end of the verse. And it was like that, God appointed the believers as successors in the earth, and made their religion possible for them in the east and west of the earth. And the Almighty said:
{It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all other religions; and God is sufficient as a witness} [Al-Fath: 28]

And it was as he had told and promised, and God Almighty said: {Say, “If mankind and the jinn gathered together to produce the like of this Qur’an, they would not produce it.” With the like of it} [Al-Isra: 88]. And it was as he told. And the Almighty said: {And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down to Our servant, then produce a surah like it} [Al-Baqarah: 23] to His saying: {And if you do not do And you will not do so, so fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.} [Al-Baqarah: 24] So he informed that they would not do it, and it was as if He told. And it was reported that he said to Christ: {And I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection} [Al Imran:
55], and it was as he reported. And he descended in Mecca:

{The crowd will be defeated and they will turn their backs} [Al-Qamar: 45], and He said: “And if those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs, then they would not find a guardian or a helper.” [Al-Fath: 22] And it was as he told it. And he said: {And among those who said, “We are Christians,” We took their covenant, but they forgot part of what they had been reminded of, so We enticed among them enmity and hatred to the point of On the Day of Resurrection} [Al-Maeda: 14], and they were as he told. And he said:

{And the Jews said, “The hand of God is bound.” Their hands were bound, and they were cursed for what they said. Rather, His hands are spread out. He spends as He wills. And He will certainly increase many of them. What has been sent down to you from your Lord is transgression and disbelief, and We have caused among them enmity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they kindle a fire for war. God extinguished it} [Al-Maeda: 64]

And it was as he told. And he said: {They will not harm you except by harm, and if they fight you, they will turn you back, and then they will not be helped. Humiliation has been struck upon them wherever they are found, except with a rope. from God and a host of people, and they incurred the wrath of God, and calamity was struck upon them. This is because they used to disbelieve in the signs of God. And they kill the prophets unjustly. That is because they disobeyed and used to transgress. [Al-Fath: 22]

And he said: {Fight them, God will punish them at your own hands} [At-Tawbah: 14]. And it was like that. They did not fight them after the revelation of the verse, but the Muslims defeated them, and Islam continued in its glory and appearance until it appeared on The people of the East and the West.
