And God Almighty said, addressing the Jews: {Say, “If the abode of the Hereafter is yours with God alone, to the exclusion of other people, then wish for death if you are truthful.” And they will never desire it for what their hands have put forward. And God is All-Knowing of the wrongdoers - And you will find them the most eager for life among those who associate others.} [Al-Baqarah: 94 - 96]. And he said:
{Say, O you who have been guided, if you claim that you are friends of God rather than of people, then wish for death if you are truthful.} [Al-Jumu’ah: 6]

So he told about the Jews that they would never wish for death, and it was as he told, the Jews never wish for death, and this is evidence from Two aspects: in terms of telling him that it would never happen, and in terms of God diverting the Jews’ motives from wishing for death, despite the fact that It is possible for them, and this is one of the most amazing and extraordinary things, and despite their keenness to deny it, their motives did not arise. To show his lie, by showing his wish for death. And he said in Surah Al-Muddaththir: {Leave me and whomsoever I created alone - and I have made for him wealth extended - and sons as witnesses} [Al-Muddaththir:

11 - 13] to his saying: {I will pray it at Saqr - and how can you know that Saqr has passed? Do not leave it and do not leave it} [Al-Muddaththir: 26-28]. He said on the authority of Abu Lahab - his uncle -: {Abu Lahab’s hands remained firm and he repented - his wealth and what he earned did not avail him - he will pray in a flaming fire} [Al-Masad: 1 - 3], And it was as he was told, Al-Walid died an unbeliever, and Abu Lahab died an unbeliever.

And he said in Surat Al-Fath: {God promised you many spoils that you would take, so He hastened these for you and restrained the hands of people from you so that they might be a sign. For the believers} [Al-Fath: 20]. And he said: {You will enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, secure, with your heads shaving and cutting your hair short, not fearing. He knew what you did not know, so He made it without That is a conquest soon} [Al-Fath: 27]. And he said: {Say to the Bedouins who remained behind: You will be called against a people of mighty might. You will fight them or they will submit. If you obey, God will give you a reward. Well, if you turn back as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.} [Al-Fath: 16].

And all of this happened as he had told, and they obtained many spoils, and they entered the Sacred Mosque safely, and the Bedouins were called to fight the Romans. The Persians fight them or submit, so it is necessary to fight or submit to Islam. There is no truce without fighting, as it was before the arrival of the Prophet. The verse.

And God Almighty said: {When God’s victory and conquest come - and you see the people entering God’s religion in droves - glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness. He was repentant} [Al-Nasr: 1-3]. So people entered the religion of God in droves after the conquest, and he, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not die, and in all of the Arab countries there was a place where he had not entered. Islam. And God Almighty said about the hypocrites:

{Have you not seen those who are hypocrites saying to their disbelieving brothers from among the People of the Book, “If you are expelled, we will surely go out with you, and we will not obey anyone among you.” Never. And if you are killed, We will certainly help you, and God bears witness. Indeed, they are liars - if they are expelled, they will not go out with them, and if they are killed, no They will help them, but if they support them, they will surely turn their backs, and then they will not be helped.} [Al-Hashr: 11-12]. And so it was, and the people of interpretation, battles, and biographies narrated that this verse was revealed about the hypocrites, such as Abdullah bin Ubayy, and Abdul God. . . . . . . . . . . .

Bin Nabtal, Rifa'ah bin Tabut, and the like, they used to say to the Banu al-Nadir, who were the Jews and their allies: {If you are expelled... We will certainly go out with you} [Al-Hashr: 11] verse. So God told them that they would not do that, and so it was, and God gave them an example of Satan: {When he said to man: Disbelieve. But when he disbelieved, he said, “I am free from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds.” [Al-Hashr: 16]. Such are the hypocrites, and Banu al-Nadir.

chapters.title: A chapter on his informing, peace be upon him, of many past and future unseen and their significance to prophecy
paragraphs: [Chapter: His being informed, peace be upon him, of many unseen things, past and future, and their significance to prophecy]

His verses, may God bless him and grant him peace, included all types of verses, both informative and actual. And his telling of the unseen, the past, the present, and the future, with wonderful things, the likes of which were not found for any of the prophets before him, let alone others. The two prophets. There is a lot of information in the Qur’an about the unseen - as some of that was mentioned above - and likewise in the authentic hadiths, which inform of its occurrence. So it was as he told. In the two Sahih books, on the authority of Hudhayfah, he said:

“The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, rose among us in a position where he did not leave anything in its place until the Hour of Judgment unless he narrated it. He memorized it and he forgot it. Whoever forgot it, these companions of mine have taught it, and that there may be something of it that I forgot, so I see it and remember it as he remembers it. A man has a man’s face when he is absent from him, then when he sees him he recognizes him.”

And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abu Zaid Amr bin Akhtab, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, led us in prayer at dawn, and ascended the pulpit. So he gave us a sermon until noon arrived, then he came down and led us in prayer, then he ascended the pulpit and gave us a sermon until noon arrived, then he came down and led us in prayer, then he went up. The pulpit and he addressed us until the sun set. He said: “And he informed us of what was and what is to come, so the most knowledgeable of us preserved it.” In Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Adi bin Hatim, he said:

“While I was with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, a man came to him and complained to him of poverty, then another came to him and complained of being cut off from his path. He said: O Uday, have you seen Al-Hira? I said: I did not see it, but I was told about it. He said: If it is long

You have a life to see the woman journeying from Al-Hira until she circumambulates the Kaaba, fearing no one but God. He said: I said to myself: Where are the prostitutes of Tayy, who priced the country? If you live a long life, the treasures of Khosrau will be discovered. I said: Khosrau ibn Hurmuz! He said: Khosrau ibn Hurmuz, if you live a long life, you will see a man bring out a palm full of gold or silver, asking for someone to accept it. And he will not find anyone to accept it from him, and one of you will meet God on the day he meets him, and there will be no interpreter between him and him to translate for him, so they will say to him:

Did I not send to you a messenger who would inform you? And he says: Yes. He says: Did I not give you money and do something better for you? He says, “Yes.” Then he looks to his right and sees nothing but Hell, and he looks to his left and sees nothing but Hell. Adi said: I heard the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, say:

Protect yourself from Hell, even if it is with half a date, and whoever does not find it, then with a kind word. Adi said: I saw the woman traveling from Al-Hira until she circumambulated the Kaaba, fearing no one but God, and I was among those who opened the treasures of Khosrau ibn Hurmuz. And if your life is long, you will see what the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He will bring out the fullness of his palm. I said: This is what was reported about, about a man going out with a palm full of gold or silver and not finding anyone to accept it, it appeared as it was reported at the time Omar bin Abdul Aziz.

And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Jabir bin Samra, on the authority of Nafi’ bin Utbah, he said: 7466 - “We were with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, on a campaign. He said: Then a group of people came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, from the west, wearing woolen clothes, and they met him at a hill, for they were a messenger. God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sitting. He said: Then my soul said to me: Come to them and stand between them and him so that they do not assassinate him. He said: Then I said: Perhaps he will be saved. With them. So I came to them and stood between them and him. He said: So I memorized four words from him that I count in my hand. He said:

You will invade the Arabian Peninsula and God will conquer it, then Persia and God will conquer it, then you will invade the Romans and God will conquer it, then you will invade the Antichrist. Then God will open it.”

Al-Bukhari narrated, on the authority of Awf bin Malik, who said: “I came to the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, during the Battle of Tabuk, 3212 - while he was in a cloak of human beings. So he said: Prepare six things before the Hour: my death, then the conquest of the Holy House, then two deaths in which you will be seized like sheep’s sheaths, then the abundance of money. Until a man is given a hundred dinars and he remains discontented, then there is a strife that leaves no Arab house without entering it, then a truce between you and the people of And they will betray you, and they will come to you under eighty targets, and under each target there will be twelve thousand.”
I said:

The Holy House was conquered after his death during the caliphate of Omar ibn al-Khattab, and after that the great plague occurred in the Levant, the plague of Emmaus during the caliphate. Omar also died, and Muadh bin Jabal and Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah died in it, and many others died, and that was the first plague that occurred in Islam, so it was He was not informed of this, as a plague took them like the slaughter of sheep, then money increased during the caliphate of Uthman ibn Affan until one of them was given a hundred A dinar, which angered her, and the amount of money increased to the point that horses were being bought for their weight. Then the general strife broke out, such that not a house of Arabs remained except She entered it when Othman was killed, and strife broke out between Muslims or kings.

The Day of Al-Jamal, and the Day of Siffin. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Khabab bin Al-Art, he said: “We complained to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, while he was cuddling up with his cloak in the shade. The Kaaba, and we faced distress from the polytheists, so we said: Will you not pray to God for us? Will you not ask victory for us? He said: Then he sat down with a red face, then he said:

By God, those before you would have a man taken and combed with iron combs between flesh and sinew. This would not turn him away from his religion. He will be taken, and a hole will be dug for him, and a saw will be placed on his head, and it will be cut in two, which will distract him from his religion, and may God complete this matter. Until the passenger travels from Sana'a to Hadhramaut, fearing no one but God Almighty.

Or a wolf on his sheep, but you are hasty.” And in Sahih al-Bukhari, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “Do not The Hour will come until you fight the Turks, small-eyed, red-faced, and nose-tipped, as if their faces were hammered shields, and the Hour will not come until You fight a people whose shoes are hairy.” I said:

And all of these sects were fought by the Muslims, as the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, told us. The matter of these sects is well known, for fighting the Turks is one of the The Tatars and others whose description is well-known and well-known, and their narration is in more than ten thousand copies of books, both large and small. The Muslims, before the fighting of those who appeared from the direction of the East, whose characteristic was such that if anyone who saw them with his own eyes was forced to He did not describe them well like this. And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said:

7203 “The Hour will not come until fire emerges from the land of Hijaz and illuminates the necks of camels in Busra.” This fire appeared in the year six hundred and fifty-four, and people saw it, and they saw the necks of camels lighting up in Busra, and it was It burns the stone and does not cook the meat. And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Saeed, and the names that the Messenger of God

May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, “He said to Ammar bin Yasser: The transgressing group will kill you.” And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Khosrau perished, and there will be no Chosroes after him, and Caesar 55 Let them perish, then there will be no Caesar after him, and let their treasures be spent in the cause of God.” And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Jabir, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “If Chosroes dies, then there will be no Chosroes after him, and if Caesar dies, then no Caesar after him, and by the One in whose hand is my soul, their treasures will be spent in the cause of God.”

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Jabir bin Samurah, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “Let a band of Muslims conquer,” or he said: Among the believers is the treasure of the Khosrau family, which is in white. And the white is a palace that belonged to Khosrau, and in Sahih al-Bukhari and others on the authority of Abu Bakra, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, “that he said about Al-Hasan: This son of mine is a master, and God will reconcile two great groups of Muslims through him. I said:

This happened, as it was told about, about thirty years after the death of the Messenger, which is the fortieth year of the Hijra, when God reconciled with goodness. Between the two great groups that were warring in Siffin, Ali's army and Muawiya's army. And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Ibn Abbas, “a man came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: O Messenger of God, last night I saw

In a dream, there is a canopy dripping with ghee and honey, and I see people covering it with their hands. Some of them are the arrogant ones and the independent ones. Then, behold, there is a persistent cause. From the earth to the sky, and I see you took it and you rose, then a man after you took it and did it, then another man took it and did it, then he took it. Another man stopped, then two actions continued for him. Abu Bakr said: O Messenger of God, my father and my mother, please leave me alone so that I may cross it. He said: Cross. Abu Bakr said:

As for the canopy, it is the canopy of Islam, and as for the one that spreads from ghee and honey, its sweetness and softness is the Qur’an, and as for the one that is self-sufficient is the one who abounds. From the Qur’an and the Qur’an, and as for the path that connects from the heavens to the earth, it is the truth that you are upon. You adhere to it, and God will exalt you. Then A man after you will take it and it will rise, then another man will take it and it will rise, then another man will take it and it will be cut off and then it will be connected to him. So he rises with it. So tell me, O Messenger of God: Am I right or wrong? He said: You are correct in some and incorrect in some. He said:
By God, O Messenger of God, you will surely inform me of what I have done wrong. He said: Do not swear.

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with him, he said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “While I was sleeping, you saw me deep in sleep.” There was a bucket on it, so I removed as much of it as God wished, then Ibn Abi Quhafa took it and removed one or two sins with it, and there was weakness in removing it - And God will forgive him. Then it turned west and Ibn al-Khattab took it. I did not see any genius from among the people removing Omar’s hair until he hit the people with a curse. And in a narration: The bucket moved westward in the hand of Omar. Al-Shafi’i said: The vision of the prophets is a revelation. And he said:

There was weakness in him, his short duration, the hasty of his death, and his preoccupation with war with the people of apostasy, from the conquest and increase that Umar achieved in Its length. And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Muhammad bin Jubayr bin Mut’im, on the authority of his father, “A woman asked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, something, and he ordered her to She returned to him and said: What do you think if I come and do not find you, O Messenger of God? He said: That is, as if it meant death. He said: If you do not find me, then go to Abu Bakr.

Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi narrated, on the authority of Abu Tha’labah al-Khushani, on the authority of Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, and Muadh ibn Jabal, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. On him

And he said: “Indeed, God began this matter with prophecy and mercy, and created succession and mercy, and created a powerful kingdom, and created force and tyranny. And wreaking havoc on the nation, they make permissible sexual intercourse, wines and silk, and they will be victorious over that, and they will be provided for eternity until they meet God Almighty.” Abu Dawud narrated, on the authority of Samurah ibn Jundub, that a man said:

“O Messenger of God, I saw as if a bucket had been lowered from the sky, and Abu Bakr, may God be pleased with him, came and took hold of its handles and drank weakly. Then Omar came and took her Iraqis and drank until he swallowed, then Othman came and took her Iraqis and drank until he swallowed, then Ali came and took With its veins, it became active and some of it oozed out on him.” And in Al-Sunan, on the authority of Safinah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “The caliphate of prophethood will last for thirty years, then you will become king.” So this was it

The year was thirty years after his death, and this included the caliphate of Abu Bakr, Omar, Uthman, and Ali. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of him, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “The earth, its easts and its wests, has been planted for me, and the dominion of my nation will reach what has been planted.” “I have some of it.” And in Sahih Muslim:

“Indeed, God has planted the earth for me, and I have seen its easts and its wests, and my nation’s dominion will reach what was planted for me of it, and I have been given the two treasures. Red and white, and indeed I asked my Lord for my nation not to destroy it with one year in general, and not to impose over them any enemy other than their souls, so he makes their eggs permissible, and indeed my Lord said to me: O Muhammad, if I fulfill a decree, it will not be rejected.

And I have given you to your nation that I will not destroy them one year for another, and that I will not impose over them an enemy other than themselves who would desecrate their homeland, even if They gathered together against them from all over the country until they destroyed one another.”

This was reported at the beginning, and his companions were very few before the conquest of Mecca, and it was as he reported, for the kingship of his nation It spread in the east and west, and it did not spread in the south and north like it spread in the east and west. Because his nation was the most just of nations. So his call spread to the regions that are in the middle of the earth, such as the third, fourth, and fifth, and he had previously said:

Chosroes perished, and there will be no Chosroes after him. And that was Khosrau ibn Hurmuz, the last of the Kasra kings, and then weak governors took over after him, and the last of them was Yazdgerd, and to him The reference to the other word: “If Chosroes dies, there will be no Chosroes after him, and if Caesar dies, there will be no Caesar after him, and by the One in whose hand is my soul.” They will spend their treasures in the cause of God.”

This was told by the king of Khosrau, and Caesar was the most powerful king on earth, so God confirmed his news regarding the succession of Omar and Uthman, so Khosrau perished, and he The last of the Kassars in the caliphate of Othman in the land of Persia, and no Chosroes remained after him, nor did the Magi remain, and the Persians had a kingdom, and Caesar, who had In the land of the Levant, and elsewhere, and there remained after him no Christian king of the Levant, Egypt, or the Peninsula, and he was called Caesar. Al-Shafi’i said: The Quraysh used to invade the Levant frequently, and much of their livelihood was from it, and they came to Iraq, and it is said:

When she converted to Islam, she mentioned to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, her fear that her livelihood would be cut off from trade in the Levant and Iraq. So she left disbelief and entered Islam, with the king of the Levant and Iraq in dispute with the people of Islam. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “If he perishes... Khosrow, and there will be no Khosrow after him. There was nothing left of Chosroes in the land of Iraq after him. And he said: “If Caesar dies, there will be no Caesar after him.” There was no Caesar in the land of the Levant, so he answered them according to what they said, and it was as he said, God cut off the obstacles from

Iraq, Persia, and Caesar of the Levant. He said about Khosrow: “May God tear apart his kingdom.” So the Kasraites had no kingdom left, and he said in “Caesar: His kingdom was established.” So their rule was established in the Roman lands, and they left the Levant, and all of this confirms one another. And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Sufyan bin Abi Zuhair, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said:

“Yemen will be conquered, and a people will come dressed in clothing, and they will be saddled with their families and those who obey them. And Medina would be better for them, if they only knew. Then The Levant will be conquered, and a people will come dressed and carry themselves with their families and those who obey them. And Medina would be better for them, if they only knew.” And in Narration: Then he leaves the city. So he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, informed of the conquest of Yemen, the Levant, and Iraq before it happened, and he informed that people would emerge from Medina. They take care of their families, and whoever

He obeyed them until these times, and they seek the countryside and abundant livelihood. He said: And the city is better for them, if they only knew. And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abu Dhar, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “Egypt will be conquered, and it is a land in which the Qirat is called, so seek Good for her family. And in a narration: So do good to its people, for they are bound by protection and compassion. So if you see two men fighting over the place of a brick, get out. From it.

Some time after the conquest of Egypt, Abu Dharr passed by the two sons of Sharhabeel ibn Hasanah, and they were disputing over the site of Labnah, so he left it. And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Suleiman bin Surad, he said: I heard the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “When the parties were driven away from him: Now We attack them, but they do not attack us.” And so it was. And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abdullah bin Amr, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “When Persia and the Romans conquer against you, that is, “A people and you.” Abdul Rahman bin Awf said: We say as God commanded us. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said:

“Or something else? You compete, then you envy each other, then you fight each other, then you antagonize each other, then you set out into the dwellings of immigrants and carry each other on the necks. “Some.” And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, “When God revealed: {It is He who sent among the unlettered people a messenger from among them reciting to them His verses. And He purifies them and teaches them the Book and the Wisdom, although before they were in clear error - and others of them when they overtake them, and He is the Mighty. Al-Hakim} [Al-Jumu’ah: 2-3]. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was asked about these others, and he said:
“If the debt were hanging on the Pleiades, men from Persia would have received it.” In a word: If only there was faith, and in a word: knowledge. And it was as he reported, for it happened in

The followers and their followers, and so on, from the sons of Persia, such as: Al-Hasan Al-Basri, Muhammad bin Sirin, Sa’id bin Jubayr, and Ikrimah Mawla of Ibn Abbas, Mujahid bin Jabr, and several times of these, those who achieved that. “And when the words of God Almighty were revealed: {God will certainly bring a people whom He loves, and they who love Him; humble toward the believers, and mighty toward the disbelievers.” [Al-Ma’idah: 54]

He was asked about them, and he said: They are the people of this, and he pointed to Abu Musa al-Ash’ari, and said: Indeed, I find the soul of the Most Gracious from the side of Yemen. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of him, he said: “The people of Yemen have come to you. They are the most tender-hearted and soft-hearted; Faith is Yemeni, jurisprudence is Yemeni, and wisdom is Yemeni.

When the one who had renounced Islam apostatized, God brought those whom He loved and who loved Him, so the truthful fought among them the people of apostasy, and defeated them. Abu Bakr, Omar, Khosrau, and Caesar. He said to Othman: God will cover you with a shirt, so if they want you to take it off, do not take it off. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Musa, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saw us in one of the walls of the city, and he was reclining and focusing on a stick in the Water and clay, when a man asked for the opening and said to him: Open and give him good tidings of Paradise.

So, behold, it was Abu Bakr, so I opened for him and gave him good tidings of Paradise. Then another man opened and said to him: Open for him and give him good tidings of Paradise. So I went and found it was Omar, so I opened for him and gave him good tidings of Paradise, then another man opened and said to him: Open for him and give him good tidings of Paradise. On a calamity that befalls him. So I went and saw it was Uthman. I opened the door for him and gave him the good news of Paradise. I told him what he said, and he said: Oh God, be patient, and God is the One who seeks help. And in the two Sahihs there is a hadith by Hudhayfah, “On the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, about the temptations that cause the waves of the sea to ripple, and he said to Omar:
There is a closed door between you and her, and that door is about to be broken. So Masruq asked him from the door?

He said: Omar. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “There will be tribulations, in which the one who sits will be better than the one who stands, and the one who stands will be better.” Whoever walks, and the one who walks in it is better than the one who runs. Whoever looks towards it seeks it, and whoever finds a refuge in it should seek refuge in it. It was narrated by Abu Bakra, and he said in it: If it falls, whoever has camels should follow his camels, and whoever has sheep should follow. With his sheep, and whoever has land, let him join his land. He said: Then a man said: O Messenger of God, what do you think if he does not have camels, sheep, or land? He said:

He reaches for his sword and hits its edge with a stone, then escapes if he is able to escape. Oh God, have I conveyed the message? O God, have I conveyed the message? Then a man said: O Messenger of God, what do you think if I were forced to be taken to one of the two ranks, or to one of the two groups, and a man struck me with his sword? Or will an arrow come and kill me? He said: He will commit his sin and your sin, and he will be among the inmates of the Fire. In the Sahih of Abu Hatim, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said:

“Woe to the Arabs because of the approaching evil, or a blind, deaf, and dumb trial, in which the one who sits is better than the one who walks, and the one who walks is better than the one who runs. Woe to the one who runs. therein from God on the Day of Resurrection.”

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of him, he said: “I see temptations occurring within your homes, like raindrops.” And in the two Sahihs it is mentioned in more than one way that “when Dhul-Khuwaysarah said to him: O Muhammad, be just, for you have not been just. He said: Woe to you, I have failed and lost if I do not act justly. Some of his friends said: Let me behead this hypocrite. Then the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: From the depths of this will emerge people of whom one of you will degrade his prayers with theirs, and his fasting with theirs. And reading it with their reading,

They recite the Qur’an but it does not go beyond their throats. They leave Islam as an arrow leaves a target. Their sign is that there is among them a man whose hand is pierced. His upper arm is like a piece of tender flesh, with hairs on it.” And in a narration in the two Sahihs: “A rogue woman suddenly passed by a group of Muslims who were being killed by the closest of the two groups to the truth.”

These people appeared twenty-few years after his death, at the end of the caliphate of Ali, when the Muslims separated, and the group was among the military Ali, and the army of Muawiyah, and Ali bin Abi Talib and his companions killed them, and they were the closest of the two groups to the truth, and the other group killed Ammar bin Yasser, which is the sect

The transgressor, and Ali had informed them of this hadith, and of their sign, so they searched for this conceived person but did not find him, until Ali rose - By himself - so he searched for him and found him killed, so he prostrated in thanks to God. And what is authentic about him is that he said: “After me there will be princes who delay the prayer beyond its time, so pray the prayer at its time, and make your prayer with them.” voluntary. These people appeared some time after that, and they used to delay the afternoon prayer until the time of afternoon prayer, and they would delay the afternoon prayer until the sun was yellowing. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of him, he said:

“You will meet a succession after me, so be patient until you meet me at the basin.” After him, they met those who influenced them and did not give them their rights. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of him, he said: “After me there will be princes who will demand from you their rights and deny you your rights. They will say: What do you command us, O Messenger of God?” God said: Give them their due, and ask God for your due. And in the two Sahih books it is narrated that “he went to Fatima and said to her while he was ill in which he died: ‘I am dying during this illness. Then he told her that she was the first of his family to follow him. And in a narration: And he told her that she is the mistress of the women of the believers.

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Aisha, she said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The quickest of you to catch up with me will be the longest.” She said: “So be.” They would argue about which of them had the longest hands. Zainab had the longest hand because she used to work with her hand.

And you give in charity.” And in Sahih Al-Bukhari and others, on the authority of Umm Haram, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “The first army to invade Constantinople “They will be forgiven.” And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Umm Haram also, she said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “The first army of my nation to invade the sea.” They made it obligatory. She said: O Messenger of God, am I among them? He said: You are among them. She said: Then the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: The first army of my nation to invade Caesar’s City will be forgiven. So I said: O Messenger of God, am I among them? He said: No.

The Muslims invaded it during the caliphate of Muawiyah, and Yazid was their commander, and in the army was Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, to whom the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, descended. And peace be upon him in his house when he came to the city as an immigrant, and he died and was buried under its walls, and they mentioned that when they were hungry, they would uncover his grave. They will be given water.

Then the Muslims invaded it a second time during the caliphate of Abd al-Malik. His son Maslama invaded it, and they besieged it for several years and built in it. A mosque. And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Anas, he said: “The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, used to go to Umm Haram bint Milhan, and she would feed him. Ubadah ibn al-Samit, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, entered upon her and she fed him and made him comb his head. He fell asleep and then woke up laughing. She said: Why are you laughing? He said:

I was presented with people from my nation riding the surface of this sea as kings on beds, or like kings on beds. Umm Haram said: Pray to God to make me one of them. So he prayed for her, then he laid down his head and fell asleep, then he woke up laughing, so she said: Why? Are you laughing? He said:

Some people from my nation were presented to me, as he said in the first case. She said: O Messenger of God, pray to God to make me one of them. He said: You are among the first. He said: Anas: She rode the sea at the time of Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan, and she was thrown off her riding animal when it came out of the sea and died. And this happened in The caliphate of Uthman and Muawiyah as his deputy. During the caliphate of Umar, the Muslims did not invade the sea. The first to invade the sea was during the caliphate of Uthman, and they conquered the island of Cyprus, and they came She was taken captive to Damascus, and Abu al-Darda’ was alive in Damascus, so he began to cry, and it was said to him:

What makes you cry, Abu Darda? This is a day on which God has made Islam great? He said: I only cry because I saw this nation being oppressive and victorious, but neglecting the command of God in it. So God made it happen to what you see. How easy are the servants of God if they neglect His command. And in the two Sahihs, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “I asked my Lord for three things, and He gave me two and withheld one from me. I asked Him not to He sheds

upon my nation an enemy from others, and he invaded them, so he gave it to me, and I asked him not to destroy them with a general custom, so he gave it to me, and I asked him not to He will put their share among them, so He will prevent them from doing so.” It is proven from him in the two Sahih books that he said: “A group of my nation will continue to adhere to the truth, and they will not be harmed by those who oppose them, nor by those who abandon them.” Until the Hour comes.”

This was told about when his nation was the smallest of nations, and the nation was spread throughout the east and west of the earth, and it was as he was told about it. For this nation - to God be praise and blessings - there is still a group that is prominent with knowledge, religion and the sword, and has not been afflicted by what afflicted those who Before that, from the Children of Israel and others, they were subjugated by their enemies. Indeed, if a group was defeated in any part of the land, it would

In the other country there was a prominent and victorious nation, and no enemy from anyone else ruled over it, but disagreement and strife arose among them. And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “There are two types of the people of Hell that I have not seen: a people with them.” Whips like the tails of cows, with which they beat people, and women clothed and naked, with their heads tilted like the humps of a camel, tilted not They will enter Paradise and will not smell its fragrance, and indeed its fragrance will be smelled from such-and-such a distance.”

These women appeared a long time after him, and the women appeared many years after that, wearing turbans like the humps of camels on their heads. Al-Bukhati, they call the turban the hump of a camel.
And in the hadith of Muslim, on the authority of Asma’ bint Abi Bakr, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said there will be a liar and a liar in Thaqif.

The liar appeared from Thaqif, and he is Al-Mukhtar bin Abi Ubaid Al-Thaqafi, who showed Shiism and victory for Al-Hussein, and killed Ubaid Allah bin Ziyad and other of the killers of Hussein, then he showed that it was revealed to him, and that it was revealed to him, until it was said to Ibn Omar and Ibn Abbas about him, it was said For one of them: it is revealed to him, and for the other: it is revealed to him. So one of them said: {And the devils will inspire their guardians} [Al-An’am: 121], and the other said: {Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend? On every sinful abomination} [Al-Shu’ara’:

221 - 222], As for Al-Mubir, he was Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf Al-Thaqafi, and he was Mubir and an unjustly shed blood, in victory for the kingdom of Abdul-Malik. Ibn Marwan, whom he requested. And in the two Sahihs, on the authority of Abu Hurairah that he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Which of you spreads his garment and takes from My speech and he gathered it to his chest, for he would never forget anything he heard, so I spread a cloak over me until he finished speaking, then I gathered it to my chest and it did not After that day, I forgot something I heard from him.” And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Jabir bin Samurah, he said:
The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Islam will continue to be powerful until the age of twelve.”

Caliphs, all of them from Quraysh. And in a narration: “Up to twelve princes,” and in a narration by Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi: “All of them, the nation will gather around them.” And in a narration, They said: “Then what will happen?” He said: Then there will be chaos. Abu Bakr Al-Bayhaqi said: In the first narration there is an explanation of the number, and in the second there is a statement of what is meant by the number, and he explained the occurrence of the chaos. And it is murder after them.

This number existed in the aforementioned capacity until the time of Al-Walid bin Yazid bin Abdul-Malik, then chaos and strife occurred. The greatest number, but they increase the mentioned number if the mentioned characteristic is left out, or those who were with them after the turmoil are counted with them. And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Jabir, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to me: Do you have any patterns? I said: O Messenger of God, how can I have patterns? Today I say to my wife: Put away your patterns. She says: Didn’t the Messenger of God say? May God’s prayers and peace be upon him: “There will be patterns for you.”

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Ibn Abbas, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “While I was sleeping, I saw that two bracelets of He went, so I terrified them and hated them, so he gave me permission, so I blew them and they flew, but I treated them as liars.

They will leave after me.” Ubayd Allah said: One of them is Al-Ansi, who was killed by Fayrouz in Yemen, and the other is Musaylimah. And in the two Sahihs, from the hadith of Ibn Umar, he said: “I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying as he was facing the east: Behold, this is the trial.” Here, the temptation is here from where the horn of Satan emerges.” And in some of Bukhari’s narrations: He stood up as a preacher and pointed with his hand towards Aisha’s residence and said: He mentioned the hadith.

The east of his city is Bahrain, and from there came Musaylimah the liar, who claimed prophethood, and it is the first event that happened after him. Khaleeq followed him, and his successor, Al-Siddiq, fought him. Abu Hatim narrated in his two Sahihs on the authority of Jabir bin Abdullah, who said: “I heard the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. He says: Indeed, before the Hour, there will be liars. Among them is the owner of Al-Yamamah, among them is the owner of Sana’a Al-Ansi, among them is the owner of donkeys, and among them is the owner of donkeys. The Antichrist, and he is the greatest tempter among them.” The owner of the dove is Musaylimah. He said: And my companions said: He said: They are close to thirty liars.

And in Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “The Hour will not come until thirty liars, impostors, come out. They all claim that he is the Messenger of God, and until the money is abundant, and temptations appear, and the

Pandemonium. They said: What is the commotion, O Messenger of God? He said: Murder, murder. And in Sahih Ibn Hibban on the authority of Abu Dharr, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, rode a donkey and led me behind him, then he said: O Abu Dharr, Where are you if people are so hungry that you cannot get from your bed to your mosque? What do you do? He said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: Be chaste. He said: O Abu Dharr, have you seen that if a severe death befalls people such that the household is occupied by a servant, what would you do? He said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: Be patient.

O Abu Dharr, have you seen that if people killed each other until the stones of oil were drowned in blood, what would you do? He said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: Stay at home and close your door. He said: What do you think if I am not left? He said: So go to whoever you are from, and be among them. He said: Should I take my weapon? He said: Then

You may participate in it with them, but if you fear that the beam of the sword will terrify you, then let the edge of your cloak fall over your face, and it will carry your iniquity and his iniquity.” And on the authority of Ibn Masoud, he said: “I came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, while he was in a cloak of human flesh, in which were forty men, and he said: You are They will be conquered, and they will be helped. So whoever of you reaches that time, let him fear God, and enjoin what is right, and forbid what is wrong, and whoever lies Ali intentionally, let him take his seat in the Fire.”

As for the conquests that were opened to them, and the victory that they were given, he was told about it at the beginning of his mission, as mentioned above, and what happened Tell him about it. Abu Hatim narrated in his Sahih, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: Abu Talib fell ill and Quraysh came to him, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to visit him. At his head was a man’s seat, so Abu Jahl got up and sat in it. They complained to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to Abu Talib, and they said: Ibn Your brother falls into our gods. He said: What is the matter with your people accusing you, my nephew? He said: Uncle,

I only wanted them to rely on one word by which the Arabs would owe them and the non-Arabs would pay tribute to them. He said: What is it? He said: There is no god but Allah. So they stood up and said: {Shall the gods be one God} [p. 5]? He said: And the verse was revealed: {By the Qur’an, which is the Remembrance} [Page: 1] until His saying: {Indeed, this is something wondrous} [Page: 5]. And in Sahih Ibn Hibban, on the authority of Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, on the authority of Qays ibn Abi Hazim, he said: When Aisha came, she brought some water Bani Amer went to them at night and heard dogs barking, so she said: What water is this? They said: The water of Al-Hawab. She said: I do not think that it is water-soluble. They said:

Wait - may God have mercy on you - come forward and the Muslims will see you, and God will be pleased with you. She said: I do not think that I am a crook, for I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: “How can the dogs of the Haw’ab bark at one of you?” It also narrates on the authority of Ibn Abi Talib, who said: “Abdullah bin Salam said to me, while I had put my foot in stitches, and I wanted to go to Iraq: Do not come.

Iraq, for if you go to them, you will be struck by the sin of the sword. Ali said: By God, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said it. Abu Al-Aswad said: So I said to myself: I have never seen a fighting man speaking to people like this today. This and others like it are what he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was told about in the future, and it happened after him, as he was told, and the people saw that.

As for what he was told about that had not happened until now, it was a lot, and he told about things of the unseen, which happened in his time, and were found as they were. He reported, as in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Sahl bin Saad, on the authority of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, “He said on the Day of Khaybar:

“I will give this banner tomorrow to a man who loves God and His Messenger, and God and His Messenger will love him, and God will grant victory at his hands.” And it was like that. And in the two Sahihs, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: “We witnessed with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Hunayn, and he said - to a man who claims to be Islam -: This is one of the people of Hell. When we attended the battle, the man fought fiercely and was wounded. It was said: O Messenger of God, the man to whom I said above is from the people of Fire, for today he fought a fierce battle, and he died, so the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: To Hell.

Some Muslims were almost in doubt, but they were of that opinion when it was said: He did not die, but he had a severe wound, and when the night came, he did not He patiently treated the wounds and killed himself. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was informed of that, and he said: God is the Greatest. I bear witness that I am the servant of God and His Messenger. Then he ordered Bilal to call out to the people: “No one will enter Paradise except a Muslim soul, and God will support this religion with the immoral man.” It was narrated by Sahl bin

Saad. And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Ali, may God be pleased with him, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, sent me, Abu Murthad al-Ghanawi, and al-Zubayr ibn Al-Awam and Al-Miqdad, and we are all knights. So he said: Go until you come to Rawdat Khakh.

For therein is a woman who has a letter from Hatib to the polytheists. Then we noticed her walking on a trotting camel, so we said to her: Where is the letter? She said: I don't have a book. He said: So we looked for it, so we sought the letter on its journey, but we did not see a letter. He said: We said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not lie. Either you will take out the letter or we will strip you. He said: When she saw that I had fallen into her custody, and she was being held captive by a cloak, she took the book out of her hand, so we took the book. So we brought it to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and behold:

From Hatib bin Abi Balta’ah to some of the polytheists in Mecca, informing them of some matter of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: God, may God bless him and grant him peace: O Hatib, what is this? He said: Do not be hasty on me, for I was a woman.

I was attached to the Quraysh, and I was not one of them, and those who were with you among the emigrants had relatives who protected their families in Mecca, so I loved I missed this because of my lineage among them, to take a hand with which to protect my kinship, and I did not do that out of disbelief, nor apostasy from my religion, nor out of consent. With disbelief after Islam. Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He has told you the truth. Omar said: Let me cut off the neck of this hypocrite. He said: He witnessed a full moon, and how do you know? Perhaps God has looked at the people of Badr. He said: Do whatever you want, for I have forgiven you.

This book contained information to the polytheists that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, wanted to attack them, so God informed him of that. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, mourned for the people the Negus on the day he died, so he went out to the prayer place.” And he said “Allahu Akbar four times,” and in a narration on the authority of Jabir, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, prayed upon Ashama al-Najashi,” and in the wording: From the narration of Abu Hurairah, he said: “Abdullah died today

Saleh Ashamah. So we believed, and he prayed upon him.” In the narration of Imran bin Husayn, he said: “Your brother has died, so pray for him.” It means Negus. It was narrated by Musa bin Uqba, on the authority of Ibn Shihab, and Urwa bin Al-Zubair narrated it, and Muhammad bin Ishaq narrated its meaning, he said:

Then, “The polytheists were fierce against the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, as hard as they had ever been, until he reached the level of effort against the Muslims, and he became hard against them.” The affliction, and the Quraysh agreed in their cunning to kill the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, openly. When Abu Talib saw the people’s deed, he gathered the Bani Abdul Muttalib and ordered them to bring the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, into their people, and to protect him from those who wanted to kill him, so they agreed on that. Muslim and non-Muslim, some of them did it out of a diet, and some of them did it

With faith and certainty. When the Quraysh learned that the people had prevented the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they agreed on that, the polytheists from the Quraysh gathered, and they unanimously agreed. He commanded them not to sit with them, not to pledge allegiance to them, and not to enter their homes until they surrendered the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to be killed, and they wrote in Their cunning is a document, covenants, and covenants. They will never accept a peace treaty from Bani Hashim, nor will they show mercy to them until they hand them over to be killed.

Banu Hashim remained among their people for three years, and the affliction and hardship became severe for them. They cut off the markets from them, leaving no food available to them. Mecca and there was no sale except that they hastened to it and bought it; They want to understand the shedding of the blood of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. Ibn Ishaq added in his narration, saying: Until the voice of their children could be heard shouting from behind the people from hunger, and they attacked those who converted to Islam. So they bound them, and they harmed them, and the calamity became severe for them, and the temptation became great, and they were shaken.

A severe earthquake. Musa bin Uqba said in the completion of his hadith: When Abu Talib was taking the people to their beds, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, commanded So he lay down on his bed until whoever wanted to deceive him and assassinate him would see it. When he put the people to sleep, he commanded one of his sons or his brothers, or his sons. His uncle, so he lay down on the bed of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and ordered the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to bring some of their beds so he could sleep. On him.

When it was the beginning of three years, men from Banu Abd Manaf, Banu Qusayy, and other men from Quraysh who had been given birth to women from Banu Hashem, and they saw that they had severed ties of kinship, and had disdained the truth, and from their night they decided to break the treachery they had agreed upon. And disavowed of it, and God Almighty sent to destroy their document, which contained deception against the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, the ground, and it licked everything There was a covenant and covenant in it, and it is said: It was hung on the ceiling of the house and was not left.

name of God Almighty in it except that she licked it, and whatever polytheism, injustice, or severing of ties of kinship remained in it, and God informed His Messenger of what It was done in their newspaper, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned that to Abu Talib, and Abu Talib said: No, by Al-Thawaqib, he did not lie to me, so he set off. He walked with a group of Banu Abdul Muttalib until he came to the mosque, and he was crowded with Quraysh. When they saw them baptizing with their group, they denied That is, and they thought that they were being brought out due to the severity of the affliction, so they came to them to give them to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, so Abu Talib spoke, He said:

Matters have occurred between you that we have not mentioned to you, so bring your document that you agreed upon, perhaps there will be reconciliation between you and us. He said that for fear that they would look at their newspaper before they brought it, so they brought their newspaper admiring it, not suspecting that The messenger was delivered to them, so they placed it among them and said: The time has come for you to accept and return to a matter that unites your people, for it has broken us apart. And there is one man among you whom you have made a threat to his destruction.

Your people, your clan, and their corruption. Abu Talib said: I came to you to give you a matter in which there is half, for my nephew told me, and he did not lie to me, that God Almighty is innocent. From this scroll that is in your hands, and erased every name that he had on it, and left in it your treachery and your estrangement against us, and your demonstration against us. With injustice, if the hadith that my nephew said is as he said, then wake up, for by God we will never surrender it until we die from the hands of the last of us, even if it is He who said it was false, We delivered him to you, and you killed him or kept him alive. They said:

We are satisfied with what you say, so they opened the scroll and found the truthful and trustworthy, may God bless him and grant him peace, who had told her story. When the Quraysh saw it, a group of people like the one who Abu Talib said: They said: By God, if

This was nothing but magic on the part of your friend, so they relapsed and went back to the evil they had been doing, such as their disbelief and hardship towards the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. He greeted the Muslims and his family and the fulfillment of what they had agreed upon. Then those group of Banu Abdul Muttalib said: Indeed, more than us are more worthy of magic and lying, so how do you see? For we know that what you have agreed upon out of our sect is closer to jubbet and magic than our matter, and had you not agreed upon magic Your newspaper has not become corrupted while it is in your hands. May God blot out whatever name was in it, and whatever transgression was in it that He left behind.

Are we the magicians or are you? At that time, a group of Banu Abd Manaf, Banu Qusayy, and men from Quraysh who were born to the women of Banu Hashim, including Abu Al-Bakhtari, said: And Al-Mu'tim bin Adiy,

Zuhair bin Abi Umayyah bin Al-Mughirah, Zamaa bin Al-Aswad, and Hisham bin Amr, and the scroll was with him, and he was from Bani Amir. Ibn Luayy regarding men of noble character and eminence. We are innocent of what is in this newspaper. Abu Jahl said: This is a matter that was decided overnight. Abu Talib wrote poetry in that regard, in reference to their newspaper, praising the group who disavowed it and undone what was in it. Covenant, and praises Al-Najashi. Musa bin Uqba said: When God spoiled the plan of their deception, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out and they lived and mixed with the people.

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Abdullah bin Masoud, he said: “Saad bin Muadh set out for Umrah and descended upon Umayyah bin Khalaf Abi Safwan. When Umayyah ibn Khalaf set out for the Levant and passed through Medina, he descended upon Saad ibn Muadh and said to Umayyah: Give me an hour of seclusion, so that I may I walk around the house. He said: Wait until the middle of the day and the people are asleep. I set off and floated around. He said: So he went out with him near the middle of the day and Abu Jahl met them. He said: O Abu Safwan, who is this with you? He said: This is Saad. Abu Jahl said: Don't I see you circling?

In the house, safe, and you have given shelter to the boys, and you claimed that you would support them and help them, but by God, had you not been with Abu Safwan, there would not have been You returned to your family unharmed, and Saad said to him, raising his voice: If you prevent me from this, I will prevent you from something worse for you than this. Your way through the city. He said: Then Umayyah said to him: Do not raise your voice against Abu Al-Hakam, the lord of the people of the valley. So Saad said: Leave you alone, O Umayyah, for by God he has I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, saying: He is your killer. He said: In Mecca? He said: I don't know.

Umayyah was greatly terrified at that, and said: By God, Muhammad does not lie. When Umayyah returned to his family, he said: O Umm Safwan, have you not seen? What did Saad tell me? She said: What did he tell you? He said: He claimed that Muhammad told them that he was my killer, so I said to him: In Mecca? He said: I do not know. She said: By God, Muhammad does not lie. Umayyah said: By God, I will not leave Mecca. When it was the day of Badr, Abu Jahl asked the people for help and said: Reclaim your caravan. He said: Umayyah did not want to leave, so Abu Jahl came to him and said:

O Abu Safwan, when people see that you have fallen behind, and you are the master of the people of the valley, they will fall behind with you. Abu Jahl did not stop until he said: When You defeated me, by God, I will buy the best camel in Mecca. He said: O Umm Safwan

Prepare me. She said to him: O Abu Safwan, you have forgotten what your brother Al-Yathribi told you. He said: No, and I do not want to pass with them except soon. He said: When Umayyah went out, he did not go down a single place without mounting his camel, and he did not continue like that until God killed him at Badr. On the authority of Ka’b bin Malik, he said: “Ubay bin Khalaf, the brother of Banu Jumah, had sworn while he was in Mecca that they would kill the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. When his oath reached the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Rather, I will kill him - if God Almighty wills. -.
Then my father came, masked in iron, saying: I will not be saved if Muhammad is saved. So he attacked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, wanting to

He killed him, so Musaab bin Umair from Banu Abd al-Dar, the protector of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, met him himself, so he killed Musab bin Umair. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, saw the collarbone of Ubayy ibn Khalaf from the gap between the back of the shield and the egg, so he stabbed him in it with his spear. Then Ubay fell from his horse, and no blood came out of his stab, so his companions came to him and carried him while he was bellowing the bull’s bellowing. They said: What? I scare you! It is only a scratch, so he mentioned to them what the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I am killing my father, then he said:
By the One in whose hand is my soul, if this had been with the people of Dhu al-Majaz, they would all have died.

Then he died and went to Hell. It was narrated by Musa bin Uqba, on the authority of Ibn Shihab Al-Zuhri, on the authority of Sa’id bin Al-Musayyab, and Al-Waqidi mentioned it with its chain of transmission, and this is its wording, This is what Urwa bin Al-Zubayr mentioned in his battles, Ibn Ishaq, and others. Musa bin Uqba mentioned in his battles, “When Umair bin Wahb Al-Jumahi returned to Mecca, most of the polytheists returned, and God had killed whoever killed them.” Among them, Umair came and sat next to Safwan bin Umayyah in the Hijr, and Safwan said: May God make life difficult after the killing of Badr. He said:

Yes, by God, there is nothing better in life after them, and if it were not for a debt I owe that I cannot pay off, and children to whom I leave nothing, I would have gone to Muhammad. So I killed him if my eyes were filled with him, for I have a problem with him that I can make excuse for. I say, “I came to my son to ransom this prisoner.” Safwan was happy. By what he said, and he said to him:

Your debt is upon me, and your children are the example of my families in terms of maintenance. So Safwan carried it and prepared it, and he ordered Umair’s sword to be polished and branded. So Umair approached until he arrived. The city, so he disembarked at the door of the mosque, mounted his mount, took the sword, and headed for the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and Omar bin Al-Khattab looked at him. While he was with a group of the Ansar talking, Omar said: You have the dog, this is the enemy of God who harassed us.

On the day of Badr, we prepared for the people. Then Omar got up and entered upon the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, until he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: What brought you forward? He said: I am a prisoner with you, so ransom us with our prisoners, for you are the clan and the family. He said: What is the matter with the sword around your neck? Umair said: May God make swords disgraceful to them, so are they of any benefit to us? I just forgot it in my neck when I came down, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: Believe me, what came before you? He said: I only came as a prisoner. He said: What did you stipulate for Safwan bin Umayyah regarding Al-Hijr?

Umair was frightened and said: What did you stipulate? ! He said: You tolerated him killing me so that he would provide for your household and pay off your debt, and God is standing between you and that. Umair said: I bear witness that you are the Messenger of God, and that there is no god but God. We used to deny you by revelation, and by what comes to you from heaven, and this “The hadith took place between me and Safwan in the Hijr, and no one saw it except me and him, so God informed you about it.” He mentioned the rest of the hadith.

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Anas, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent people from Banu Sulaym to Banu Amir in the course of seventy, and when They came forward, and my uncle said to them: I will come before you. If they trust me, I will inform them of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. Otherwise, you will be close to me. So they trusted him, and while he was speaking to them about the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, they pointed to a man among them and he stabbed him and he executed it. He said:

I won, by the Lord of the Kaaba. Then they turned against the rest of its companions and killed them, except for a lame man who ascended the mountain and another with him. Gabriel told the Prophet May God bless him and grant him peace. They have met their Lord, and may God be pleased with them and pleased with them. So we used to recite, “Inform our people on our behalf that we have met our Lord, and He has been pleased with us and pleased us.” Then he abrogated and called for them for forty mornings on a camel. Dhakwan and Banu Lahyan, and the disobedience of those who disobeyed God and His Messenger, and among these was Aamir bin Fuhayra.

Amer ibn al-Tufayl said about him: I saw him raised to the sky after he was killed, to the point that I could see the sky between him and the earth. And in the two Sahihs, from the hadith of Abu Humaid al-Sa’idi, he said: “We went out with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, in the Battle of Tabuk, and we came to Wadi al-Qura. On a woman’s garden, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Prune it, so we pruned it, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, pruned it. Ten awsuq, he said:

Count it so that we will return to you, God Almighty willing. So we set off until we came to Tabuk, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: It will blow upon you tonight. A strong wind, so that no one can stand up from it. Whoever has a camel, let him tighten its harness. Then a strong wind blew, and a man got up and the wind carried him until it threw him. With a tall mountain. Imam Ahmad narrated, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The one who captured Abbas Ibn Abd al-Muttalib was Abu Al-Yusr Ibn Amr, who was Ka’b Ibn Amr Ahad

Bani Salamah. Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: How did you capture him, O Abu Al-Yusr? He said: A man helped me against him whom I had never seen before or before. He looked like this and that. Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: A generous king has helped you against him. And he said to Al-Abbas: O Abbas, redeem yourself, and your brother’s son Aqeel bin Abi Talib, and Nawfal bin Al-Harith, and your ally is Utbah bin Jahadam, the brother of Bani Al-Harith bin Fihr. He said: I was a Muslim before that, but they forced me to do so. He said:

God knows best about you. If what you claim is true, God will reward you for that. As for your apparent matter, it was against us, so redeem yourself. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, had taken twenty ounces of gold from him. He said: O Messenger of God, count it for me as part of my ransom. He said: No, that is something God gave us from you. He said: I have no money. He said: Where is the money that you put in Mecca when you went out to Umm al-Fadl and no one was with you except the two of you? So you said: If I am injured in this journey of mine, then such-and-such is due to Al-Fadl, such-and-such is to Qutham, and such-and-such is to Abdullah.
He said, “By the One who sent you with the truth, none of the people knew about this except me and her, and I know that you are the Messenger of God.”

And in Sahih Al-Bukhari: “When the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent the army in the Battle of Mu’tah, and commanded Zayd ibn Haritha against them, and said, ‘If he is killed Then Jafar, and if he is killed, then Abdullah bin Rawahah. Al-Bukhari narrated, on the authority of Anas bin Malik, who said: The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, mourned Zaid, Ja’far, and Ibn Rawaha to the people before he Their news comes to them, and he said:

Zayd took the flag and was injured, then Ja’far took it and was injured, then Abdullah bin Rawaha took it and was injured, and the eyes of the Messenger of God May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, and they were shed, then Khaled bin Al-Walid took them as one of God’s swords, until God granted victory over them.”

chapters.title: A chapter on his verses, may God bless him and grant him peace, related to power, action, and influence
paragraphs: [Chapter: His signs, may God bless him and grant him peace, related to power, action and influence] [The splitting of the moon and guarding the sky with meteors are signs of prophecy]

His verses, may God bless him and grant him peace, related to power, action, and influence, are of various types, the first of which is: what is in the upper world. Like the splitting of the moon, and guarding the sky with meteors, the complete guarding of what was sent, like his ascension to the sky. God has mentioned the splitting of the moon, He explained that God did it, and told of it for two great wisdoms: one of them: that it was one of the signs of prophecy, when the polytheists asked him for a sign. He showed them the splitting of the moon.

The second: It is an indication of the permissibility of the splitting of the heavens, and that this is evidence of what the prophets told of about the splitting of the heavens. For this reason God Almighty said:

chapters.title: The splitting of the moon and guarding the sky with meteors are signs of prophecy
paragraphs: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split open} [Al-Qamar: 1] (1) {And if they see a sign, they will turn away and say, “Continuous magic.”} [Al-Qamar: 2] (2) {And they deny and follow Their desires, and every matter is settled.} [Al-Qamar: 3] (3) {And indeed there has come to them of news, in which there is something reprehensible} [Al-Qamar: 4] (4) {Extensive wisdom, so what Vows will be of no avail.} [Al-Qamar: 5] (5) {Then turn away from them on the Day when the caller calls for something reprehensible.} [Al-Qamar: 6] (6) {With humbled eyes, they will emerge from the events. As if they were spreading locusts.} [Al-Qamar: 7] (7).

So he mentioned the approaching of the Hour, and the splitting of the moon, and made the sign in the splitting of the moon rather than the sun and all the other planets. Because it is closer to the Earth than the sun and the stars, and the split in it occurred without the rest of the parts of the orbit. Since it is the enlightened body in which the schism appears to everyone who sees it in an unmistakable way, and when He - Himself - accepts Parting, then accepting its place is more deserving of that, and the people witnessed it and witnessed it, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, used to recite this Surah in Large academies such as:

Friday prayer, and the two Eids, so that people can hear the verses of prophecy and its evidence, and take into account what is in it. Everyone acknowledges this and does not deny it, so it is known that the splitting of the moon was known to people in general. And in Sahih Muslim, “Umar bin Al-Khattab asked Abu Waqid Al-Laythi:

What did the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, recite during Eid al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr? He said: He used to recite in them “Q and the Glorious Qur’an” [Q: 1], and “The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split asunder” [Al-Qamar: 1].” It is known of necessity and custom that if he had not defected, those who believe in him would have hastened to deny that, in addition to His enemies are the infidels and hypocrites, and it is known that he was one of the people most keen on people believing him and following him. If he had not defected, When he used to inform about it and read it to all people, and used it as evidence, and made it a sign for him.

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Anas bin Malik, he said: “The people of Mecca asked the Prophet of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to show them a sign, but he saw division in them.” The moon twice.

On his authority, he said: “The people of Mecca asked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to show them a sign, and the moon split into two parts.” Al-Tirmidhi narrated it, and added to it, and it was revealed: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split open} [Al-Qamar: 1]. To the Almighty’s saying: {Continuous magic} [Al-Qamar: 2]. He says: Going. And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Ibn Masoud, he said: “The moon was split into two parts during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: And peace be upon him: Bear witness.

“Also on the authority of Ibn Masoud, he said: I saw the moon split in two parts in Mecca before the exit of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, one part on Mount Ubay Qubays, and Shaqqa on Suwayda. Then the infidels of Quraysh - the people of Mecca - said: This is magic with which Ibn Abi Kabsha magicked you. Look to the magicians, if they are They saw what you saw, then it was true, and if they did not see what you saw, then it is magic. He said: The travelers were asked, and they came from every direction, and they said: We saw. Narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

Al-Bukhari narrated, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, that he said: The moon split open during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. Muslim narrated, “On the authority of Ibn Umar in the Almighty’s saying: {The Hour has approached and the moon has been split open} [Al-Qamar: 1]. He said: This was during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. The moon was split into two parts, a part below the mountain, and a part behind it. The mountain, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Oh God, bear witness. On the authority of Jubayr bin Mutim, who said: The moon split while we were in Mecca until it became two parts on this mountain, and on this mountain, so the people said:
Muhammad has bewitched us! A man said: If he bewitched you, then he did not bewitch all the people. He narrated it

Al-Tirmidhi. Likewise, his ascension on the night of the Ascension to what is above the heavens, and this is what has been reported in hadiths, and the Qur’an has told about it. It has told By his journey at night from the Sacred Mosque to Al-Aqsa Mosque, which is the Holy House, and in another place by his ascension to the heavens, and he said God Almighty: {Glory be to Him who took His servant by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Aqsa Mosque, which We have blessed around it to show him of Our signs. He is the Hearer, the Seeer} [Al-Isra: 1]. So he reported here about his journey at night between the two mosques, and he reported that he did that to show him one of His signs.
It is known that the earth and all people have seen the signs on it, so he knew that this would show him signs that the generality of people had not seen, as he said in Surah The other:

{Will you examine what he sees?} [An-Najm: 12] (12) {And he saw it another time} [An-Najm: 13] (13) {At the Sidrat al-Muntaha} [An-Najm: 14] (14) {With it is a Paradise. Shelter} [An-Najm: 15] (15) {When the grove covers what it covers} [An-Najm: 16] (16) {The sight has not deviated nor has it been overshadowed} [An-Najm: 17] (17) {He has certainly seen of signs His Lord is the Greatest} [Al-Najm: 18]. And in the two Sahihs, “on the authority of Ibn Abbas, in the Almighty’s saying: {And We did not make the vision which We showed you except as a test for the people} [Al-Isra: 60]. He said: It is an eye vision that I showed the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, on the night he was taken on the journey.

And in telling him about the journey - that We might show him of Our signs - there was an explanation that he saw of its signs what the people had not seen, and he explained that in the Surah. The other, for he saw Gabriel at the Sidrat al-Muntaha: {Therein is the Garden of refuge} [An-Najm: 15] (15) {When He covered the Sidrat with what it covered} [An-Najm: 15] 16].

And he saw with the sight the great signs of his Lord, and he mentioned in that Surah Al-Mighty Journey; Because he was able to establish proof of it. For when he told them about it, those who denied him denied him, and they were astonished at that. They asked him about his description and description, and he described him to them, but he did not make a hole in it. He described something, and told the news of their caravan that was on the road, so his sincerity appeared to them, and his sincerity in this was a sign of his sincerity in what was absent. About them, and covering a long distance was easy because of what I saw of the signs that prophets are specific to seeing.

In this way, he is distinguished from one who crosses a distance out of respect for a guardian or by subjugating the jinn, as in the story of Bilqis, where: {A demon from the jinn said, “I will come to you.” before you arise from your position, and indeed, in Him I am strong and trustworthy.} [An-Naml: 39] (39) {The one who has knowledge of the Book said, ‘I will bring it to you before That your desire may return to you} [An-Naml: 40]

For the crossing of a body over a long distance was only due to what Solomon was given by the kingdom, just as the wind used to flow: “It flows at ease wherever it is commanded.” He struck} [p. 36] (36) {And the devils, every builder and diver} [p. 37] (37) {And others bound together in shackles} [p. 38] (38). This is royal servitude. And Muhammad’s interruption, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was due to what God showed him of the signs that distinguished him over the rest of the prophets, and that was a trial, that is, a trial. And as a test for the people, so that those who believe in him may be distinguished from those who disbelieve in him.
