Likewise, those who unanimously agreed on its origin in predestination, for them there is no difference between the karamat of saints and the miraculous properties of magicians, but The saint is obedient to God, and the magician is disobedient to God. This is the mainstay of these people who lack wisdom and reasons for the actions of God Almighty.

The majority of people disagree with them and say: This statement is corrupt. Rather, the very concept of it is sufficient in knowing its corruption, for if it resembles This and this from every perspective. So how is it known about the existence of this or its obligation, and the absence or abstention of this, and if it is said: Documents of habit. It was said to him: Your opponents say: This is invalid on two counts: One of them: That you allow the custom to be broken, but not for you to break it. A reason that is specific to it, and no wisdom has been contradicted for its sake. Rather, there is no difference to you between its contradiction of the prophets, the saints, and the magicians. And other than that, and that is why you said:

There is no difference between the miracles of the prophets and the miracles of the saints and magicians except merely the conjunction of the claim of prophecy and the challenge of opposition with Lack of opposition, although the challenge of opposition may come from the polytheist or even from the magician, they have not proven a difference that goes back to the supernatural genre. The object, nor to the intention of the agent and the Creator, nor to his ability, nor to his wisdom.

The second: that the habit must have causes and obstacles by which it can be known for its continuation at times and its discontinuation at other times, and from this the answer appears. Regarding what they said about turning the mountain into gold, the sea into mercury, and human beings into monkeys, and the like, it is possible and known to be permissible with knowledge. Because it did not happen, they are told: The majority of people do not know to you that this is possible except with its requirements and the absence of its opposites. Then it will be said: Why did you say that this does not entail reasons that come before it?

And obstacles are removed, like all the extraordinary things that God causes, for He does not cause anything except by creating causes and a prompting. Obstacles, for example, the drowning of Noah’s people. It was not water that came into being without a reason. Rather, God sent down the water from the sky and caused the earth’s water to spring up, as He said. Almighty:

{The people of Noah were denied before them, so they denied Our servant and said, ‘He is mad and he is disdainful.’” [Al-Qamar: 9] (9) {Then he called on his Lord, ‘I am defeated,’ and he was victorious.” [Al-Qamar: 10] (10) {Then We opened the gates of the heaven with pouring water} [Al-Qamar: 11] (11) {And We caused springs to gush forth on the earth, and the waters met upon a matter that had been decreed} [Al-Qamar: 12] (12) {And We carried it on a platform of planks and pillars} [Al-Qamar: 13]

And likewise, when Aad had destroyed them, he sent down the roaring wind for seven nights and eight days of decisiveness, as God Almighty said: {Then you will see the people therein quarreled. It is as if they were the trunks of empty palm trees} [Al-Haqqah: 7] (7) So do you {see for them any remaining} [Al-Haqqah: 8]

Likewise, Thamud, Salih said to them: {And, oh my people, this she-camel of God is a sign for you, so leave her to eat in God’s land and do not touch her with any harm. Then a near doom will seize you.} [Hud: 64] (64) {So they licked it, and He said, “Enjoy yourself in your home for three days. That is a promise that will not be false.} [Hud: 65] (65) {So when Our command has come. We will deliver him righteous and those who believed with him, out of mercy from Us and from disgrace on that Day. Indeed, it is your Lord, the Powerful, the Mighty.} [Hud: 66] (66) {And those who wronged took the cry and became crouched in their homes} [Hud: 67] (67) {As if they had not sang therein. Indeed, Thamud disbelieved in their Lord. A distance from Thamud} [Hud: 68]
And everything that is found in the world of supernatural customs:

The verses of the prophets, and other than them, nothing came of them except for reasons that preceded them, like the verses of Moses, such as the fate of a living staff. After he cast it, either at God’s command to do so when he called him from the tree, and he saw the extraordinary fire, or at Pharaoh’s request. to him by the sign, or when he opposes the magicians to swallow their ropes and their staffs, and likewise the rest of his signs, even the drowning of Pharaoh was after The march of the army, and the sea struck him with a staff, and similarly the water gushed out of the stone after he struck the stone with his staff, and he rained. His people treated him to it, while they were in a wilderness with no water.

Likewise are the verses of our Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, such as adding water, by placing his hand in it until the water gushed out from between the fingers, i.e. The water gushing out from between the fingers did not come out from the fingers themselves. Likewise, the water in the well was increased either by throwing an arrow into it. Like his tongue in it, or by pouring the water in which he spat into it, and likewise Christ used to take the form of a bird from the clay and blow into it. So it will be a bird, God willing, and things like that.

As for a mountain that turns into ruby without the reasons mentioned above, this did not happen, nor will it be. Likewise, a river that is expelled becomes milk without Reasons necessitating this are created by God, so this neither happened nor will be. And whoever says: A thing is possible, this means two things: Mental possibility and external possibility.

The mental possibility is the lack of knowledge of abstention, and this involves nothing but the lack of knowledge of abstention, and the lack of knowledge of abstention is nothing but Knowledge of possibility. Everyone who did not know the impossibility of something considered it possible in this regard, but this is not knowledge of its possibility. And whoever proves the possibility of a thing by saying that if it were destined, nothing impossible would be necessary for it, without explaining the non-existence of the necessity of every thing, as a group does. Among the people of theology, such as Al-Amidi and the like, there was nothing in what he mentioned except mere claims. As for the second:

This is the knowledge of the possibility of something outside. This is known by knowing its existence, or the existence of its counterpart, or the existence of what is closer. To avoid it, if it was possible for the camel to carry a quintal, it would be better for him to carry ninety pounds, and in this way The way in which God explains in the Qur’an the possibility of what He wants to explain is possible, such as the resurrection of the dead and the Day of Resurrection. Sometimes He explains that by an explanation. Its occurrence, as it was reported that Moses’ people said:
{We will not believe in you until we see God clearly} [Al-Baqarah: 55]. . .
{Then the thunderbolt took them while they were looking.} [Al-Dhariyat: 44], Then God resurrected them after their death that they might give thanks.

And as he told about the murdered man whom they struck with a cow, and God revived him, just as He said: {And when you killed a soul and then turned around in it, by God A way out is what you were concealing.} [Al-Baqarah: 72] (72) {Then We said, “Strike him with some of it. Thus does God bring to life the dead and show you His signs that you may understand.”} [Al-Baqarah: 73]

And just as he told about those who left their homes in thousands, he warned of death, and God said to them, “Die,” and then he brought them back to life. And just as he told about the one who: {. . .

He passed by a town and its thrones were empty. He said, “How can God revive this woman after her death?” Then God caused him to die for a hundred years, then resurrected him. He said, “How many?” You remained. He said, “You remained a day or part of a day.” He said, “Rather, you remained for a hundred years. So look at your food and drink. It has not been long. And look at the Your donkey, and let us make you a sign to the people. And look at the bones, how We make them splinter, then they cover them with flesh. When it became clear to him, he said, “I know that God is over all things.” A mighty thing} [Al-Baqarah: 259]

And God Almighty told a parallel to that in the story of Abraham, where He said: {. . . My Lord, show me how You revive the dead. He said, “Do you not believe?” He said, “Yes, but to reassure my heart.” He said, “Take four of the birds and divide them to yourself, then make On every mountain a portion of them, then call upon them and they will come to you running, and know that God is Mighty, All-Wise” [Al-Baqarah: 260].

Glory be to Him as evidence for something greater than that, which is the first creation, and the creation of the heavens and the earth, as He said: {Is it not He who created the heavens? And the earth is capable of creating someone like them.} [Yasin: 81]

And he said: {If you are in doubt about the Resurrection, then indeed We created you from dust, then from a sperm, then from a clot, then from an embryo, created and uncreated. That We may make clear to you, and confirm in the wombs what We will, for an appointed term, then We will bring you out as infants, then that you may attain your strength.} [Al-Hajj: 5]. . .
To his saying: {And you see the earth lifeless, but when We send down water upon it, it shakes and grows and produces every delightful kind.} [Al-Hajj: 5]

So God Almighty established the possibility of life by beginning with the creation of animals and with the creation of plants, and He mentioned that in the Qur’an in more than one place. The extension of this has another place.

What is meant is that the one who said: This is possible does not need any evidence. The lack of knowledge of its impossibility is not sufficient in knowledge of its possibility. And God, Glory be to Him, has power over all things, and what is impossible is nothing according to the agreement of wise people, and everything that God created, He must create its requirements. Its opposites are impossible, otherwise it is impossible for the necessary to exist without the necessary, and the combination of two opposites is impossible, and the servants have no knowledge of the requirements of each. A created being and there are no opposites that contradict its existence.

To assert the possibility of its existence without knowledge of its concomitants, their possibility, their opposites, and their absence is ignorance, and God Almighty is capable of He changes whatever part of the world He wills, and He rends the heavens, and moves the mountains, and covers them with clothing and turns them into scattered dust, for example That is what God has informed us of, just as He creates everything He creates with whatever reasons He facilitates, and this will be explained in another place.

What is meant here is that the signs of the prophets and the evidence of their truthfulness are varied before and when they are sent, during their lives, and after their death. Before the Message is like the news of it to those of the prophets who preceded it, and like the indications indicating it, but when the Message is apparent, As for during his life, it represented his victory, deliverance, and destruction of his enemies, and after his death, it represented the victory of his followers, and destruction of His enemies, as God Almighty said: {Indeed, We will certainly help Our messengers and those who believe in the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand} [Ghafir: 51]

And the Almighty said: {And indeed Our word preceded to Our sent servants} [Al-Saffat: 171] (171) {Indeed, they will be helped.} [Al-Saffat: 172] (172) {And indeed, they will be helped.} [Al-Saffat: 172] (172) {And indeed We are the ones who overcome.} [As-Saffat: 173]

And he said to Christ: {I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Myself, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve, until the Day of Resurrection} [Al Imran: 55]. . .

And he said: {O you who have believed, be helpers of God, as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples. “Who are my helpers to God?” The disciples said, “We are Helpers of God, so a group of the Children of Israel believed, and a group disbelieved, so We supported those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious.} [As-Saff: 14]

And for Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, clear signs were created for him before he was sent, when he was sent, during his life, and after his death until The Hour, and until the Hour comes, for his mention, and the mention of his book, and the glad tidings of that are present in the previous books as it has been explained in Its location.

And Al-Khalil prayed for him, and he said in his supplication for his descendants: “Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from among them who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Scripture.” And wisdom and purifies them} [Al-Baqarah: 129]

When he was born, some signs that are known were associated with his birth, and that year the famous story of the Companions of the Elephant took place, and it happened to him in The period of its creation, of the signs and evidence, are many matters, some of which have been mentioned in the books of evidence of prophecy, biography, and other things, such as the verses Which happened to his wet nurse when he was with her, and similar to what was seen in his conditions when he was young, and as for God’s victory for him and his followers, And exalting his remembrance, spreading his tongue of truthfulness, destroying his enemies, humiliating those who oppose him and oppose him, and making his religion superior to every religion. By hand, tongue, evidence, and proof, this is something whose details would be long to describe.
God Almighty said:

{Certainly there has been a sign for you in two groups that have met; one group is fighting in the way of God and the other is disbelieving. They see them as the same as they are, the sight of the eye, and God supports. With His help whomsoever He wills. Indeed, in that is a lesson for those with insight.} [Al Imran: 13]

And God Almighty said: {It is He who brought out those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think that they would go out and they thought Because their strongholds protected them from God, so God came to them from where they had not expected and cast terror into their hearts. They destroyed their homes with their own hands. And the hands of the believers, so consider, O you who have sight.} [Al-Hashr: 2]

And the prophets, may God’s prayers be upon them, and their believing followers, and if they are tried in the beginning, then the end will be for them, as God Almighty said. When he told the story of Noah, For the righteous} [Hud: 49].

And in the hadith agreed upon as authentic, when “the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent a messenger to the king of the Romans, and he asked for someone to tell him about his history, and it was Those responsible at that time, his enemies, did not believe in him. So he said: How is the war between you and him? They said: The war between us and him is a quarrel that will prove against us one time, and we will be judged by him the next time.
He said: Likewise, the messengers are tested, and the consequences will be for them.
For it was the day of Badr that God gave victory to the believers, then on the day of Uhud the believers were tested, then the infidels were not helped after that until God appeared. Islam

If it is said: Among the prophets are those who were killed, just as God told us that the Children of Israel kill the prophets unjustly, and among the immoral people are those who God will give him dominion and authority, and will give him authority over sinners just as He gave Nasr the power over the Children of Israel, and just as He gives authority to the disbelievers of the polytheists and the people of The Book is sometimes against Muslims. It was said: As for any of the prophets who are killed, they are like those of the believers who are killed in jihad as a martyr. God Almighty said:

{And as if there was a prophet with whom many of my rabbis fought, but they did not weaken when what befell them in the cause of God, nor did they weaken, nor did they submit. And God loves. The Patient} [Al Imran: 146] (146) {And their speech was nothing but that they said, “Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our extravagance in our affairs, and make firm our feet.” And grant us victory over the disbelieving people.} [Al-Imran: 147] (147) {So God gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter, and God loves the doers of good.} [Al-Imran: 148]

It is known that whoever of the believers is killed as a martyr in battle, his condition is more perfect than the condition of one who dies without his own nose. God Almighty said: {And do not think that Those who were killed in the cause of God are dead, but alive, with their Lord being provided for.} [Al Imran: 169]
For this reason the Almighty said: {Say, “Do you wait for Us except one of the two good ones?” [At-Tawbah: 52]

That is, either victory and victory, or martyrdom and Paradise, then the religion for which the martyrs fought will triumph and emerge, and its followers will be happy in This world and the Hereafter, whoever of them is killed will be a martyr, and whoever of them will live will be victorious and happy, and this is the ultimate goal of victory, as it was Death is inevitable, and death in the way that brings happiness in this world and the hereafter is more complete, unlike one who perishes himself and his group. Neither he nor they will achieve what they seek, neither in this world nor in the hereafter.

And the martyrs among the believers fought of their own choice, and they did the reasons for which they were killed, such as enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong. They chose this death either because they intended martyrdom, or because they intended to become martyrs, knowing that they would be happy in In the Hereafter, and in this world, with the victory of their sect, and with the tongue of truth remaining in praise and supplication for them, unlike those of the disbelievers who perished, for they perished. Without them choosing perdition with which they had no hope of happiness in the hereafter, neither they nor their group attained any happiness in this world. Rather, they were followed in This world is a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the reprehensible, and it was said about them:

{How many gardens and springs have they left behind} [Al-Dukhan: 25] (25) {And crops and a noble abode} [Al-Dukhan: 26] (26) {And a blessing therein in which they were fruitful} [Al-Dukhan: 27] (27) {Likewise And We made it bequeathed to other people.} [Al-Dukhan: 28] (28) {Then the heaven and the earth did not weep over them, nor did they look back.} [Al-Dukhan: 29]

God Almighty has told us that many of the prophets were killed, and with him were many rabbis, that is, many thousands, and that they were not weak, nor were they subdued. Therefore, rather, they asked forgiveness for their sins that were the reason for the appearance of the enemy, and that God gave them the reward of this world, and the good reward of the Hereafter, If this was the killing of believers, then what do you think about the killing of the prophets, for they and their followers will have some happiness in this world and the hereafter? He is one of the greatest farmers.

The appearance of the infidels over the believers is sometimes due to the sins of the Muslims, such as on the day of Uhud. If they repent, they are victorious over the infidels, and it was The outcome for them is just as something like this happened to the Muslims in most of their battles with the infidels, and this is one of the signs and signs of prophecy. And its evidence, for if the Prophet fulfilled his covenants and commandments, God helped them and made them victorious over those who disobeyed him, so if they neglected his covenants Those people prevailed over them, so the cycle of victory and appearance with following the Prophet, in presence and absence without any reason, competes with that, and the rotation of rule with description. Existence and non-existence without interference is another description that necessitates knowledge that orbit is a cause of circle.
And we said: (without competing with another description):

It removes the incoming contradictions. This extrapolation and tracing shows that God’s victory and victory is due to following the Prophet, and that Glory be to Him, He wants to raise His Word and His victory and the victory of His followers over those who disagree with Him, and to make happiness for them, and misery for those who disagree with them. This necessitates knowledge of his prophecy, and that whoever followed him was happy, and whoever dissented from him was miserable, and from this the appearance of Nasr upon the Banu Banu Nasr. Israel, for it is one of the indications of the prophecy of Moses, as the appearance of the victory of Nasr occurred only when they changed their covenants with Moses and abandoned following him, so they were punished. Thus, when they were followers of the covenants of Moses, they were supported and supported, just as they were in the time of David and Solomon and others.
God Almighty said:

{And We decreed to the Children of Israel in the Book that you will certainly spread corruption in the land twice and that you will declare great exaltation} [Al-Isra: 4] (4) {So when the promise of the first of them came to pass. We sent against you servants of Ours who were endowed with great might, so they spied through the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.} [Al-Isra: 5] (5) {Then We returned the attack to you upon them. And We have provided you with wealth and children, and made you more numerous in army.} [Al-Isra: 6] (6) {If you do good, you do good to yourselves, but if you do evil, it is yours. Then when the promise of the Hereafter comes, they will disdain your countenance and enter the mosque as they entered it the first time, and they will disavow what they have risen to with purity.} [Al-Isra:
7] (7) {Perhaps your Lord will have mercy on you, but if you return, we will return} [Al-Isra: 8]

The appearance of the Children of Israel against their enemy at times, and the appearance of their enemy at times, was evidence of the prophecy of Moses, may God bless him and grant him peace, and likewise The appearance of the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, over their enemy at times, and the appearance of their enemy against them at other times is one of the signs and signs of Muhammad’s message. His prophecy, and God’s victory was given to Moses and his people over their enemy during his life and after his death, as happened to them with Joshua and other evidence. The prophecy of Moses, as well as the victory of the believers with Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, during his life and after his death with his caliphs, are among the signs of his prophecy. And its evidence, and this is in contrast to the disbelievers who sometimes defeat the People of the Book, those whom those who obey them do not say:

I am a prophet, and they do not fight the followers of the prophets on the basis of religion, nor do they ask those to follow them on the basis of their religion. Rather, they may declare that We were only victorious against you because of your sins, and if you had followed your religion, we would not have been victorious against you. Also, there is no consequence for them. Rather, God will destroy the oppressor. against the oppressor, then He destroys all the oppressors, and the one who killed them does not seek happiness after death by killing him, nor do they choose killing in order to be happy after Death, as this and others like it are what demonstrate the difference between the victory of the prophets and their followers, and the emergence of some disbelievers over Believers or the appearance of some of them over others.

It is clear that the appearance of Muhammad and his nation over the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, is of the same nature as their appearance over the idol-worshiping polytheists. This is one of the signs of his prophecy and evidence of his message. It is not like the appearance of the victory over the Children of Israel, or the appearance of the infidels over the Muslims. This verse is what was told to Moses, and it is clear that the liar who claims to be a prophet will not fulfill his command, but rather the command of the truthful one will be fulfilled. People of the Book who say:

Muhammad and his nation were subjected to authority over us for our sins despite the validity of our religion that we follow, just as Bukhtnasr and other kings were subjected to authority, and this is an analogy. Corrupt, for Bakht-Nasr did not claim prophethood, nor did he fight for religion, nor did he ask the Children of Israel to move from the law of Moses to his law, so he did not His appearance was in fulfillment of what he claimed of prophethood and what he called for in religion. Rather, he was like bandit warriors when they appeared on the road. Caravans, other than those who claimed prophethood and a religion that he preached, and promised its people happiness in this world and the hereafter, and threatened its opponents with the misery of this world. And the Hereafter, then God helped him, made him victorious, completed his religion, exalted his word, made for him the outcome, and humiliated his opponents, for this is one of the The type of violation of customs that is associated with the claim of prophethood is evidence of it, and that is the type of violation of customs that is not associated with the claim of prophethood. It is not evidence of it.

Many nations may drown in the sea, but that would not be evidence of a prophet’s prophecy, unlike the drowning of Pharaoh and his people, for it was a clear sign. to Moses, and this agrees with what Moses, may the peace and blessings of God be upon him, told him, that a liar will not complete his mission, and that is because God is All-Wise and it is not appropriate With it you support the liar in his lie without making it clear that he is lying, and for this reason the greatest temptation is the temptation of the lying antichrist when it is associated with his claim. There were some supernatural phenomena that indicated his falsehood in many ways, including:

His divine claim is that he is one-eyed, and God is not one-eyed. An infidel is written between his eyes. Every believer, reader or non-reader, will read it. By God God Almighty, no one will see him until he dies, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned these three signs in authentic hadiths. As for supporting This has never happened, so who can provide evidence of what the Lord, Glory be to Him, does according to custom and Sunnah? This is the reality, and whoever uses wisdom as evidence for that, his wisdom contradicts his doing that, since the wise man does not do this, and he has God Almighty said:

{And if those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned back. Then they would not find a guardian or a helper.} [Al-Fath: 22] (22) {The Sunnah of God which has passed away before, and you will never find it. To change the Sunnah of God} [Al-Fath: 23]
So he informed that the Sunnah of God, which cannot be changed, is the victory of the believers over the unbelievers.

The faith required for this includes obedience to God and His Messenger. If faith is broken by sin, the matter is according to it, as happened on the day of Uhud. And God Almighty said: {And they swore by God the best of their oaths, that if a warner came to them, they would be better guided than any of the nations. But when a warner came to them, some It has only increased their repulsion.} [Fatir: 42] (42) {Arrogance in the land and evil scheming. And evil scheming only befalls its people. So will they wait for anything other than the law? Of the ancients, you will not find any change in the laws of God, nor will you find any change in the laws of God.} [Fatir: 43]

So he informed that the unbelievers only look to the Sunnah of the ancients, and there is no substitute for the Sunnah of God, it can be replaced by something else or changed, so how will victory be? To the unbelievers over the believers who deserve this name, and likewise He said about the hypocrites - and they are the unbelievers inwardly rather than outwardly - and those in it. Division of Hypocrisy: {If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease and those who tremble in Medina do not desist, We will certainly tempt you with them, and then they will not be your neighbors. Therein except a little.} [Al-Ahzab: 60] (60) {Cursed wherever they find themselves, they will be seized and utterly killed} [Al-Ahzab:
61] (61) {The Sunnah of God is among those who passed away before, and you will not find an alternative to the Sunnah of God} [Al-Ahzab: 62]

The Sunnah is the custom, for this is the known custom of God, so if one who claims prophethood and his followers is victorious over the one who opposes him, or apparently And inwardly, or inwardly, a firm victory. This was evidence that he was a true prophet, since it was the Sunnah and custom of God to help the believers. with the truthful prophets against the disbelievers and hypocrites, just as his Sunnah is supported by clear verses, and this is one of them, and whoever claims Prophethood while he is a liar, so he is one of the most disbelievers and the most unjust of the wrongdoers. God Almighty said:

{And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie against God or says, “It has been revealed to me” when nothing was revealed to him, and who says, “I will send down the like of what God has sent down.”” [Al-An’am: 93]
And God Almighty said: {Who is more wrong than he who lies about God and denies the truth when it has come to him} [Az-Zumar: 32]
And God Almighty said: {So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie against God to lead people astray without knowledge? Indeed, God does not guide the wrongdoing people.} [Al-An’am: 144]

And whoever is like that, God hates him, hates him, and punishes him, and his matter will not last. Rather, it is as the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said in the hadith. It is authentic on the authority of Abu Hurairah that he said: “Indeed, God gives dictates to the oppressor, but when He seizes him, He does not let him go.” Then he read: {And thus does your Lord seize when He seizes And they are unjust. Indeed, his seizing is very painful.} [Hud: 102]

He also said in the authentic hadith on the authority of Abu Musa that he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The likeness of a believer is like raw material from the crops.” The winds buffet it, sometimes it straightens it and sometimes it tilts it, and the hypocrite is like a cedar tree, which remains firm on its root until... “Her drying up once.”

If a liar and an immoral person is given a state, it must disappear completely, and his blame and his bad language in the world must remain, and it appears. Quickly and will disappear quickly, like the state of Al-Aswad Al-Anasi, Musaylimah Al-Kadhab, Al-Harith Al-Dimashqi, Baba Al-Rumi, and the like.

As for the prophets, they are often tested, so that they may be tested by calamity. God only empowers the servant when he is tested, and their situation becomes clear in some way. Something like crops. God Almighty said:

{Muhammad is the Messenger of God, and those with him are harsh against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. You will see them bowing down and prostrating, seeking bounty from God and satisfaction. He has appointed them in Their faces are from the effect of prostration. That is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel like a seed that has put forth its shoots, and He has strengthened it and it has grown strong and is straight. On its stems the farmers are astonished, that they may enrage the disbelievers with them. God has promised to those of them who believe and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.} [Al-Fath: 29]

For this reason, the first to be followed by the weak people, taking into account these matters, and the Sunnah of God regarding His saints and truthful prophets, and in The enemies of God and the false prophets, which necessitates a difference between the two types, and between the evidence of the true prophet and the evidence of the false prophet.

The trial of the Prophet and the believers was mentioned, and then the outcome was for them in more than one place, as God Almighty said: {And indeed I have denied messengers from Before you, they patiently endured what they were denied and were harmed until Our help came to them, and there is no one to change the words of God. And indeed there has come to you of the news of the messengers.} [Al-An'am: 34]

And God Almighty said: {Or did you think that you would enter Paradise, and when there comes to you the likeness of those who passed away before you? affliction and affliction touched them, and they were shaken. Until the Messenger and those who believed with him say, “When has God given us victory? Indeed, God’s help is near.” [Al-Baqarah: 214]

And God Almighty said: {And We did not send before you except men to whom We revealed from the people of the towns. Have they not traveled in the land and seen what was its end? Those before them, and the abode of the Hereafter is better for those who feared. Do you not understand?} [Yusuf: 109] (109) {Even when the messengers despaired and thought that they had They lied. Our help has come to them, so We save whom We will, and Our punishment will not be averted from the criminal people.} [Yusuf: 110] (110) {Indeed there is a lesson in their stories. For those of understanding, it is not a fabricated hadith, but the confirmation of what is before it, and an explanation of everything, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.} [Yusuf: 111]

chapters.title: Separating the evidence of prophecy, news that carries encouragement and intimidation
paragraphs: [Chapter: Evidence of prophecy is news that carries encouragement and intimidation]

It should be known that there are two types of evidence: a type that indicates mere knowledge of what is indicated, and a type that encourages desire along with that. In it or fear of it, the first: of the type of abstract goodness, and the second:

Of the type of urging, requesting, will, commanding something and forbidding it. This is like someone who knows that in such-and-such a place there are inanimate objects or Animals or plants for which he has no purpose, neither love nor hatred, so he is not in the same position as someone who knows that his friend is in such-and-such a place. And his child, and his beloved, and his wealth, and his family, and the people of his religion, and in such-and-such a place his enemy, and his hater, and whoever blocks his path, And he kills him and takes his money. Likewise, all the evidences of prophecy indicate the truthfulness of the Prophet. Then he will know what the Prophet informs of the matter. And the prohibition, and the promise and the threat, because he informed about that from God, and He is truthful in what He informs, so this is a correct and general path.

As for proving the prophethood of the prophets by what He did to them and to their followers of salvation, happiness, victory, good consequence, and what He made it a tongue of truth for them, and what he did to his deniers and opponents of destruction, torment, and evil consequence, and making them follow the curse in this world. With the torment of the Hereafter, this indicates, along with the sincerity of the prophets, the desire to follow them, and the fear of disobeying them, as this indicates knowledge of their truthfulness. And admonition, and admonition is a command and a prohibition with encouragement and intimidation. The Almighty said: {And if they had only done what they are advised to do} [An-Nisa: 66]. . .
That is, they are commanded to do it, and He said: “Allah exhorts you never to return to the like of it, if you are believers” [An-Nour: 17]

That is, God forbids you from repeating the same, and this path is more complete and more eloquent in achieving the goal, as it benefits knowledge of their truthfulness. And the desire to follow them, and the fear of opposing them, and it indicates the validity of the religion to which they called, the happiness of its people, and the corruption of the opposing religion. Because of their religion, and the misery of its people.

For this reason, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, used to recite in the Eid prayer the words “qāf” and “the Hour has drawn near” because of the explanation of that in them, and Surat (Qāf) was recited on Fridays, as it is comprehensive in proving the prophecies, the Day of Resurrection, and explaining the condition of the followers of the prophets and those who oppose them in This world, as God Almighty said, about it {Lied before them the people of Noah and the companions of the land and Thamud} [Q: 12] (12) {And Ad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot} [Q: 12] 13] (13) {And the people of the thicket and the people of Tuba’: each of them denied the Messengers, but his promise came true} [Q: 14]

chapters.title: A chapter on asking for a second and third verse, and the wisdom behind the succession of verses indicating prophecy
paragraphs: [Chapter: Whoever seeks a second or third sign and the wisdom behind the sequence of verses that indicate prophecy]

It should be known that when God sends a prophet and he brings a sign indicating his truthfulness, the argument is established and the argument is demonstrated. Whoever asks them for a second verse, his response is not obligatory to do so, and it may not be appropriate for that, because if he brings a second verse He was asked for a third, and if he brought a third, he was asked for a fourth. The request of the stubborn ones does not last long, and it is known that an argument was established against him in An issue of knowledge or one of the rights of the people over which they are disputing, and he said:

I will not accept it until a second or third argument is established against him. He was an oppressor and a transgressor, and it is not necessary to answer him to that, and the rulers do not enable him to do so. The opponents are not of that, but if the evidence is established against the plaintiff, he will be judged accordingly, and if the person sought says: I want a second or third piece of evidence, And fourthly, he was not obliged to do so, for the rights of God which He has made obligatory upon His servants from His Oneness, and belief in Him, and in His Messengers are more deserving if He establishes A clear proof that made it obligatory for creation to believe in His Messengers. It is not necessary to answer the questioner until a second or third time.

Then there may be wisdom in the sequence of verses, so God Almighty continues between the verses, just as He sent Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, with multiple verses to the general public. His call and its comprehensiveness. The more evidence there is, and it converges on one meaning, the more certain, clear, and easier it is to know the truth. Someone who does not know the other knows the significance of one of the pieces of evidence, and this may be conveyed unless this is conveyed, and prophets may be sent with signs. one after the other, and the hearts of the unbelievers are hardened from faith, as the verses follow one after the other, so that this may spread and appear, and this may reach a people. others, so that would be a reason for their faith, as he did with the verses of Moses, and the verses of Muhammad, as it was mentioned in the Torah that he hardens the heart of Pharaoh so that the His wonders and signs, and just as He repels the deniers from believing in Muhammad until they oppose him and strive to oppose him, and the slander in His verses appears. Thus, their inability to oppose the Qur’an and other of its verses, so this is part of the complete manifestation of its verses and proofs, unlike what if He followed it from the beginning without that, because he thought that they were able to oppose him, and he was also certain about that. His patience, his striving, and the certainty of those who believe in him, and their patience and striving are what will bring them great ranks in this world and the hereafter.

Wisdom may require that he not be sent with verses that require the punishment of eradication, as God mentioned in His Book, that the infidels were They suggest verses to the prophets other than the ones they came, and God sometimes answers them to that because of the wisdom and interest in it. Sometimes he does not answer them because of the harm and corruption it entails among the majority of religious sects among Muslims and others who say: He does it out of wisdom, and whoever does not explain his actions attributes it to pure will, and he says:
It is a habit and a practice from God, even if He does not do this for this person.

The Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, may have asked for those verses out of his desire for them to believe in them, so he was answered that the verses do not require Guidance, rather it necessitates the establishment of the argument, and necessitates a severe punishment for whoever disbelieves in it, and God Almighty may reveal many verses along with He imprinted it on the heart of the disbeliever, as he did to Pharaoh, Abu Lahab, and others, because of the great wisdom in that, as he indicated that. The Qur’an, the Torah, and others, and it has been made clear that it does not show it because there is no wisdom in it or because of the presence of corruption. God Almighty said:

{And they swore by God the best of their oaths: If a sign comes to them, they will believe in it. Say, “The signs are only with God, and what makes you feel that when they are It came while they did not believe.} [Al-An'am: 109] (109) {And We will transform their hearts and their eyes as they did not believe in it the first time, and We will leave them in They are blinded by their transgression.} [Al-An'am: 110] (110) {And if We had sent down to them the angels, and the dead had spoken to them, and had gathered together against them all things before, they would not have been They will believe only if Allah wills, but most of them are ignorant.” [Al-An’am: 111]

And God Almighty said: {And nothing prevented Us from sending signs unless the ancients denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel, seeing, but they were wronged by it, but We did not send. with signs except for fear} [Al-Isra: 59]

Glory be to Him has made it clear that nothing prevented Him from sending the signs except the denial of them by the ancients who deserved to be destroyed by them. So if he denies them These people deserved what those people deserved of the torment of eradication, and this meaning is mentioned in most books of interpretation and hadith, and other books. The books of the Muslims, and it is known for its proven chains of transmission from the Companions and those who followed them in goodness. The commentators have mentioned what was narrated by the people of The interpretation, the hadith, the musnad, and other hadiths from Al-A’mash, on the authority of Ja’far bin Iyas, on the authority of Sa’id bin Jubayr, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said:

“The people of Mecca asked the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to make Al-Safa gold for them, and to remove the mountains from them so that they could plant. He said: So it was said to him: If you wish, you can seek comfort from them, and if you wish, you can give them what they asked. If they disbelieve, they will perish just as you were destroyed before them. He said: No, but I will seek protection from them. Then God revealed this verse:
{And nothing prevented Us from sending signs except that the ancients denied them} [Al-Isra: 59]

Ibn Abi Hatim and others narrated on the authority of Malik bin Dinar, who said: I heard Al-Hasan Al-Basri say: “And nothing prevented us from sending signs except If the ancients denied it.} [Al-Isra: 59]
He said: As a mercy to you, O nation, indeed, if We had sent signs and you denied them, what befallen those before you would have happened to you.

And in the Gospel: The Jews asked Christ for a sign from heaven, and Christ said to them: The immoral nation asks for a sign, and it will not be given except an example. The sign of Noon. Indeed, signs were brought by Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, verse after verse, but they would not believe in them. The Almighty said: {And not a sign of their Lord comes to them except that they turn away from it.} [Al-An’am: 4] (4) {Indeed, they denied the truth when it came to them. Then there will come to them news of what they used to mock.} [Al-An'am:

5] (5) {Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them? We established them in the earth as We had not established for you, and We sent down the heaven upon them in destruction. And We caused the rivers to flow beneath them, so We destroyed them for their sins and created after them another generation.} [Al-An’am: 6] (6) {And if only We have sent down to you a book on paper, and they touched it with their hands. Those who disbelieve will say, “This is nothing but clear magic.” (Al-An’am: 7) (7) And they say, “Why was it not revealed to him?” A king. And if We had sent down a king, the matter would have been decided. Then they would not be repaid.} [Al-An’am:

8] (8) {And if We had made him a king, We would have made him a man and clothed them with what they wear} [Al-An’am: 9] (9) {And indeed messengers before you were mocked, so it was deplorable. [Al-An’am: 10] 11]

Glory be to Him has informed that signs will come to them, and not a sign comes to them but they turn away from it, and that by denying the truth they will see What the Messenger brought was true, just as those before them were destroyed because of their sins, which are to deny the Messenger, for God says: {And your Lord is not He will destroy the towns until He sends into their towns a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We will not destroy the towns unless their people are wrongdoers.} [Al-Qasas: 59]

And He informed of the severity of their disbelief that if He had sent down to them a book on paper and they had touched it with their hands, those of them who disbelieved would have said, “This is nothing but Clear magic, and Glory be to Him explained that if He had made the Messenger an angel, He would have made him in the image of a man, since they could not bear to see the angels in their images. At that time, confusion arose because they thought that the Messenger was a human being and not an angel, and God Almighty said: {And they said, “We will not believe in you until you blow for us from the earth.” A spring} [Al-Isra: 90] (90) {Or you will have a garden of palm trees and grapes, and through it you will cause rivers to gush forth with abundance} [Al-Isra:

91] (91) {Or cause the sky to fall on us, as you have claimed, as a covering, or bring God and the angels forward} [Al-Isra: 92] (92) {Or have a house of Or you will be promoted in the sky, and we will not believe in your advancement until you send down to us a book that we may read. Say, “Glory be to my Lord. Have I ever been anything but a human being and a messenger?” [Al-Isra: 93] (93) {And nothing prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, “God has sent a human being as a Messenger.” [Al-Isra: 94] (94) {Say, “If only he were on the earth.” Angels walk in tranquility. We have sent down to them from heaven an angel and a messenger.} [Al-Isra: 95] (95)

And these are the verses which they proposed, and if they were answered with them and did not believe, the torment of eradication would come upon them, as mentioned above, and also they are among what is not appropriate. Bringing it, because their saying, “Until you gush forth for us from the earth a spring,” implies that the spring should be gush forth in the land of Mecca and it will become a valley. He has crops, and God, from His wisdom, placed his house in a valley without crops so that he would not have what souls desire from this world, and he would be Their Hajj is for the sake of this world, not for God, and if he has a garden of palm trees and grapevines during which he makes the rivers burst forth with explosiveness, this is an expansion of This world is what necessitates a decrease in his rank and a decrease in his status. The same applies if he has a house of decoration, and the decoration is gold, and as for Making the sky fall in pieces, this will not happen until the Day of Resurrection.

And he did not tell them that this would not happen except on the Day of Resurrection, so their saying “as you claimed” is a lie to him, unless they want to imitate it, and it will be. The analogy is invalid, and as for bringing God and the angels earlier, this is when the people of Moses asked about something other than him, and the thunderbolt took them away. God Almighty said: {And when you said, “O Moses, we will never believe in you until we see God plainly.” Then the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.} [Al-Baqarah: 55] (55) {Then We resurrected you after your death that you may be grateful.} [Al-Baqarah: 56] As for the sending down of the Book, God Almighty said:

{The People of the Book ask you to send down to them a book from heaven. Indeed, they asked Moses something greater than that, so they said, “Show us God plainly.” So you took them. The thunderbolt of their injustice, then they took the calf after clear proofs had come to them, so We pardoned that, and We gave Moses clear authority.} [An-Nisa: 153] (153) {And We raised above them the Mount with their covenant, and We said to them, “Enter the gate prostrate,” and We said to them, “Do not transgress the Sabbath.” And We took from them a covenant. thick} [An-Nisa’:

154] (154) {Because they broke their covenant, and disbelieved in the verses of God, and killed the prophets unjustly, and said, “Our hearts are uncircumcised. Allah is against her because of their disbelief, but they believe only a little.} [An-Nisa: 155] (155) {And because of their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander} [An-Nisa: 156] (156) {And their saying, “Indeed, We killed the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the Messenger of God.” But they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear to them, and those who differ therein are among the They have no knowledge of it except following suspicion, and they did not kill him with certainty. [An-Nisa: 157] (157) {Rather, God raised him up to Himself, and God is Mighty, Wise.} [Women:

158] (158) {And there is not one of the People of the Book except that he will believe in him before his death, and on the Day of Resurrection he will be a witness over them} [An-Nisa: 159] (159) {But because of injustice on the part of those who are Jews, We have forbidden to them good things that were made lawful for them, and because they have turned away from the path of Allah much} [An-Nisa: 160] (160) {And usury seized them. And they have forbidden it} [An-Nisa: 161]. . . .

Glory be to Him has made clear that the polytheists asked Him to send down a Book, and that the People of the Book asked Him for that, and Glory be to Him has made clear that the two sects do not believe When that came to them, they only asked him out of obstinacy, so he said about the polytheists: {And if We had sent down to you a book on paper and they had touched it with their hands, those who They disbelieved. This is nothing but clear magic.} [Al-An'am: 7]

It was reported on the authority of the People of the Book that they asked Moses something greater than that, which is seeing God openly. He said: “The People of the Book ask you to A book was sent down to them from the sky. They asked Moses, “Is greater than that?” They said, “Show us God openly.” Then the thunderbolt caught them because of their wrongdoing. Then they took action. The calf after clear proofs had come to them, so We pardoned that, and We gave Moses clear authority.} [An-Nisa: 153] (153) {And We raised above them the Mount. With their covenant, and We said to them, “Enter the gate prostrate,” and We said to them, “Do not transgress the Sabbath.” And We took from them a solemn covenant.} [An-Nisa’:

154] In addition to this, they broke the covenant, disbelieved in the verses of God, and killed the prophets unjustly, and things like that, and it was because He wronged them and turned them away from the path of God. He made forbidden to them good things that were made lawful for them. This was part of consideration for the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Indeed, this is the nation that denies you, who are not guided.

When the proposed verses that they proposed came to them, their coming would not be of benefit to them, but rather they would contain something that would make them worthy of punishment. If it came to them and they did not believe in it, and the matter was made difficult for them, then such positive verses were not to be sent down. The punishment of eradication has greater mercy and wisdom.

God offered Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, to destroy his people when they denied him, and he said: Rather, I seek refuge with them, perhaps God will bring him out of Their descendants are those who worship God and do not associate anything with Him, as in the two Sahih books on the authority of Aisha that she said to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Did he come Is there a day more difficult for you than the Day of Uhud? He said:

I have encountered some of your people, and the worst I have encountered from them was on the Day of Aqaba, when I presented myself to Ibn Abd, O Lail Ibn Abd Kulal. He answers me to what I wanted, so I set out on my face, and I was worried, and I did not wake up until I was by the horn of a fox, so I raised my head and behold, I With a cloud that shaded me, and therein was Gabriel, and he called me and said: God has heard the words of your people, and they have not responded to you.

He has sent the Angel of the Mountains to you so that you may command him to do whatever you wish regarding them. Then the King of the Mountains called me and greeted me, and said: God has heard the words of your people, and they have not responded to you, and He has sent me to you so that you may command me to do whatever you wish. I wanted to close the two woods on them. He said: Rather, I hope that God will bring forth from among their descendants one who will worship God, not associating anything with Him. They took him out.

When Christ was asked for the table, it was one of the signs that required a punishment for whoever disbelieved in it, no one in the world would have punished him. God Almighty said: {When the disciples said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, is it possible for your Lord to send down to us a table from heaven?” He said, “Fear God if you are Believing} [Al-Ma’idah: 112] (112) {They said, “We want to eat from it and for our hearts to be at peace, and to know that You have told us the truth, and to be witnesses to it.”” [Al-Ma’idah: 112]

113] (113) {Jesus, son of Mary, said: O God, our Lord, send down to us a table from heaven that will be a feast for us, for the first of us and the last of us, and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the Best of Providers.} [Al-Ma’idah: 114] (114) {Allah said, “Indeed, I am sending it down to you. But whoever of you disbelieves after that, I will punish him with a punishment that I will never disbelieve.” I will punish him as none of the worlds.} [Al-Ma’idah: 115] And before the revelation of the Torah, God would destroy those who denied the Messengers with a torment.

Extermination is an urgent punishment with which God will destroy all deniers, just as He destroyed the people of Noah, and as He destroyed Ad, Thamud, and the people of Midian. And the people of Lot, and just as he destroyed the people of Pharaoh, and showed many miracles when he sent Moses, so that their remembrance and news would remain on earth, since it was After the revelation of the Torah, He did not destroy a nation with the torment of eradication. Rather, God Almighty said: {And We gave Moses the Scripture after We had destroyed the centuries. The first} [Al-Qasas: 43]

Rather, when the Children of Israel did what they did of disbelief and transgressions, some of them would be tortured and others would remain, since they did not agree On disbelief, and for this reason a nation of the Children of Israel will still remain on earth. God Almighty said when He mentioned the Children of Israel: {And We divided them into nations in the land; some of them were the righteous, and some of them were less than that, and We tested them with good deeds. And evil deeds that they may return} [Al-A’raf: 168]

And God Almighty said: {Among the People of the Book is a standing nation reciting the signs of God during the night, and they prostrate themselves} [Al Imran: 113] (113) {They believe. By Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and they hasten in good deeds; those are among the righteous.} [Al Imran: 114]

And it was from His wisdom and mercy, Glory be to Him, the Most High, when He sent Muhammad that He should destroy his people with the torment of annihilation, just as the nations were destroyed. He accepted them, but He tortured some of them with different kinds of torment, just as He tortured groups of those who called Him a liar with different kinds of torment, like the mockers whom He said God is among them: {Indeed, We have sufficed you with mockers} [Al-Hijr: 95] (95) {Those who establish with God another god; they will surely come to know} [Al-Hijr: 95]

96] So God punished each one with a known punishment, like the one against whom the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, called for one of his dogs to be mastered over him, and it was. He was taking care of his people, then the lion came to him and took him from among them and killed him, and the likes of that, and this was preceded, and God Almighty said:
{Say: Are you waiting for us except one of the two good things? And we are waiting for you, lest Allah afflict you with a punishment from Him or from our hands} [At-Tawbah: 52]

So he was told that he tortures the disbelievers sometimes at the hands of his believing servants with jihad and the establishment of punishments, and sometimes with a punishment other than that, so it was He tortures them with such reasons, which forces most of them to believe, as happened to the Quraysh and others, for they would not have denied him if He destroyed them just as He destroyed the people of Pharaoh and those before them: they were destroyed, and the benefit of it was cut off from them, and no offspring remained for them. You believe in Him, unlike when they tortured some of them with different types of torture, even if they were defeated, captured, and killed, as they were tortured on the Day of Judgment. Badr, for this is part of their humiliation and oppression, which necessitates their helplessness despite their survival. If souls are capable of fulfilling their purposes, then there is no She almost abandons it, other than if she is unable to complete her goals, then that is what calls her to repent, as it is said:

It is infallibility not to be appreciated. So what happened to them was disabling and rebuking and called for repentance, and for this reason their common people became safe after that. Only a few of them were killed, and they were The pedants of disbelief, one of whom was in this nation like Pharaoh in that nation, as it was narrated that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said, “On the authority of my father Ignorance: “This is the Pharaoh of this nation.” God mentioned to Moses in the Torah: “I will harden the heart of Pharaoh, so he will not believe in you so that My signs may be revealed.” And my wonders

He explained that this was part of the wisdom of spreading his verses indicating the truthfulness of his prophets on earth, as Moses had been informed of God’s words. For him, and by writing the Torah for him, God revealed signs whose remembrance will remain on earth, and among that was the hardening of his heart. Pharaoh did not have to destroy him and his entire people, and Pharaoh was ungrateful to the Maker, denying his lordship and not acknowledging him. Therefore He came from verses that were appropriate to his situation, and as for the children of Israel with Christ, they acknowledged the first book, so they did not need anything like it. Moses and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, needed it. He did not need to confirm the type of prophecy, as the messengers before him had brought what had been proven. That, and his people were acknowledging the Maker, but the need was to confirm his prophecy, and despite this, God appeared at his hands from The verses are like the verses before him and greater, and despite this, he did not bring verses of eradication by which the one who denies them deserves immediate public punishment. Just as the people of Pharaoh and Hud, and Salih and Shuaib and others deserved it. For this reason, God makes clear in the Qur’an that these verses, when they come, will not It will benefit them since they believed in it, but it will harm them since they deserve the punishment of eradication if they lie at that time, and despite the presence of The impediment and lack of requirement does not make the action appropriate, according to the opinion of the majority of those who claim wisdom, and those who have not given an explanation.
He does not ask for a reason or wisdom, but rather refers the matter to pure will. God Almighty said: {And nothing prevented Us from sending signs except that the ancients denied them} [Al-Isra: 59]

And He knows that the hearts of these people are like the hearts of those of the ancients, so they deny it and deserve by it what those people deserved, like the people of Noah. Hud, Salih, Shuaib, Lot, and others. He - the Almighty - said: {Thus, no messenger came to those before them except that they said: A sorcerer or a madman} [Al-Dhariyat: 52] (52) {Have they enjoined each other with him? Nay, they A tyrannical people} [Al-Dhariyat: 53] (53) {Then turn away from them, for you are not to blame} [Al-Dhariyat: 54] (54) {And remember, for indeed the reminder benefits the believers} [Al-Dhariyat: 55]
And God Almighty said: “Those before them said the same as their words; their hearts were alike” [Al-Baqarah: 118]
And God Almighty said about the People of the Book: {They imitate the words of those who disbelieved before} [At-Tawbah: 30]

And the Almighty said: {Are the disbelievers of you better than those? Or do you have an innocence in the punishment?} [Al-Qamar: 43] (43) {Or do they say, We are all victorious?} [Al-Qamar: 44] (44) {The crowd will be defeated and they will turn back.} [Al-Qamar: 45] (45) {Rather, the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is worse and more bitter} [Al-Qamar: 46]

This was mentioned in Surah (Al-Qurtubat), in which the splitting of the moon was mentioned, and their turning away from the signs, and their saying: This is continuous magic. And disbelieving them, and following their desires, so God Almighty said: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split asunder} [Al-Qamar: 1] (1) {And if they see a sign, they will turn away. And they say it is continuous magic.
Then he said: {And indeed there has come to them of news that contains something incomparable} [Al-Qamar: 4]

That is, from the news of the unseen, and what was reported about it is doubled, that is, what deters them from disbelief, since in those news there was a statement of truth. The Messenger, and a warning to those who lie to him of torment just as the predecessors were tormented. That is why he says at the end of the story: {So how was my torment and warning?} [Al-Qamar: 16]

That is, how was My punishment for the one who denied My messengers? And my warning about that before his coming clarifies the truth of his statement that I informed the messengers about, and his punishment for the one who He lied to them, then he mentioned the story of the liars such as Noah, Hud, Salih, and Lot, up to his saying: {And indeed the warning had come to the family of Pharaoh} [Al-Qamar: 41] (41) {They denied all of Our signs, so We seized them with the punishment of Mighty, Powerful} [Al-Qamar: 42]

For the people of Pharaoh denied all the signs of Moses, and all the signs of the prophets before him, and they denied the signs that indicate the existence of the Lord and His power. And His will, since they were ungrateful to the Creator, denying Him, so they denied all of His signs. Then He said: (Your unbelievers) O nation to whom He was sent. Muhammad is better than those. [Al-Qamar: 43]
Those who denied Noah, Hud, Salih, Lot, and Moses {Or do you have innocence in righteousness?} [Al-Qamar: 43] (43) {Or do they say, We are all victorious?} [Al-Qamar: 44]

This is because the fact that you will not be tortured like they were tortured if you lied is either because you are better than them and do not deserve something like that. They deserve it, or because God has informed that He will not punish you, so you will have innocence in punishment, and you will know that by His experience, for what He does is Sometimes God knows through His experience, and sometimes He knows through His Sunnah, wisdom, and justice. Either you learned this from this side or from this side. This face, this face, if one looks at what God has done that mankind has no power to do, and if one looks at the power of the Messenger and his followers, they say: {We are all victorious} [The Moon:
44] For they are more numerous and stronger, as God Almighty said:

{And when Our verses are recited to them as clear signs, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of the two parties is better in station and better as a companion?” [Maryam: 73] (73) {And how much? We destroyed a generation before them, and they were better in furnishings and in appearance.} [Maryam: 74] That is, wealth and appearance, and God Almighty said: {The crowd will be defeated, and they will turn away. [Al-Qamar: 45]

He was informed of their defeat, while he was in Mecca with a small number of followers and a weakness among them, and no one would normally think that his command He appears and rises before he migrates to Medina, and before he fights them, and it was as he reported, that on the day of Badr and elsewhere they were defeated. He gathered them together, and they turned their backs, and that is the law of God regarding the believers and the unbelievers. God Almighty said: {And if those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned back. Then they would not find a guardian or a helper} [Al-Fath: 22] (22) {The Sunnah of God which has passed away from And you will not find any change in the Sunnah of God.} [Al-Fath: 23]

And wherever the infidels appear, it is only because of the sins of the Muslims that caused a decrease in their faith. Then, if they repent, by completing their faith, they will be helped. God, as the Almighty said: {And do not become weak, nor be sad, for you will be superior if you are believers} [Al Imran: 139]
And he said: {Whenever a calamity befalls you, you have befallen it twice as much. You say, “How is this?” Say, “It is from yourselves.” [Al Imran: 165]

So if it is a matter of perfect wisdom and mercy that He does not destroy them completely as He destroyed the deniers, and the verses that They proposed it as causing the punishment of annihilation, just as the nations were destroyed before them, as He said: {Your unbelievers are better than those} [Al-Qamar: 43]

It was that he would not come under the punishment of eradication, even though He, Glory be to Him, brought what would establish the argument and clarify the argument, and would be more complete in wisdom. And mercy, since the signs He brought brought about complete goodness, benefit, guidance, clarification, and proof against those who disbelieved, and what He abstained from it from the torment of annihilation, destruction, and general torment, which necessitated the survival of the majority of the nation until they repent and believe. And they will be guided, and in sending Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, since he was the Seal of the Messengers, there was profound wisdom and abundant blessings that was not present in The message of another messenger, may God’s prayers be upon them all.

chapters.title: Separating everything that is said in proving prophecy is related to the nature of the news
paragraphs: [Chapter: Everything that is said in proof of prophecy is related to the nature of the news]

The whole speech in prophecy is connected to the speech in the news genre, for the saying of the one who says: I am the Messenger of God to you, is a piece of news, and likewise His words, actions, and signs reach us through news, and sometimes the news is identical to what he informs, such as the truth known to him. It is true, and sometimes it is not consistent with what is reported, such as a lie that is known to be a lie, and something that is not consistent with intentional lying, and with the belief that it is Truthful: If he is not excused, such as a mufti without ijtihad is justified, and a hadith narrator without knowledge is also called a liar, as he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said:
“Abu al-Sanabel ibn Baakak lied,” and what he said to those who said:
The act of Amir bin Al-Akwa’ was invalidated when he killed himself by mistake: “Whoever said that lied. He was a jihadist and a mujahid.”

The correspondence may be in the speaker’s care, or it may be in the addressee’s understanding if the pronunciation matches what the speaker meant, and not It matches the understanding of the addressee. This also may be called lying, or it may not be called it, and it includes objections, but it is permissible for necessity even if it does not happen. What is meant is, rather he is commanded to remain silent about it except with clear evidence, for he may be called a liar according to the Almighty’s saying: {If they had not brought against him four Witnesses. But since they do not produce witnesses, those are liars in the sight of Allah.} [An-Nur: 13].

What is meant here is that the news may be known to be true, or it may be known to be a lie, and neither of them may be known, and knowledge is Honesty has two meanings: One of them: that it is known that it is identical with what he informs from other than the informant’s side, as if he told us things that he knows are Truth without knowledge and the second:

To know that the person informing about it is truthful about it, and the two things may come together that he knows the veracity of what he was told about, and he knows that he is truthful about it, The saying of Muhammad (I am the Messenger of God) is from this point, as we will explain, God willing. Likewise, the fact that it is a lie may be meant by it as being Contrary to the one who informed him, even if the one who told him did not intentionally lie.

What may be meant by it is that the one who said it is deliberately lying, and for this reason the hadiths that are known to be false are of two types: Sometimes it is known that Its owner deliberately lied, and sometimes he made a mistake, and among the Companions was not known to have anyone who deliberately lied to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Likewise, among the majority of the Followers, it was not known among them who would deliberately lie, but a small group of the Shiites were known to have some who would deliberately lie. Lying in contrast to other people of whims and desires, such as the Kharijites, for there was not among them anyone known for lying. Rather, it is said:

They are among the most truthful people in speech, and the immoral man known to lie must be truthful about some news, for there will not be among the people those who do not He only tells a lie, and for this reason God Almighty said:
{If a sinner comes to you with news, then investigate.} [Al-Hujurat: 6]

In the other reading: So confirm them, so he commanded clarification and confirmation if he told the sinner something, and he did not command it to be disbelieved merely Informing him because he may sometimes tell the truth. When God Almighty commanded clarification and confirmation of the news of a sinner, this indicates that it is not permissible. Believing him simply by telling him, since he is a sinner who may lie, and it is also not permissible to deny him before it is known that he has lied, even if he is An immoral person, because the immoral person may speak the truth, and this is as the Almighty said: {O you who have believed, when you strike in the cause of God, then investigate [al-Nisa’: 94].
And in the other reading (so be steadfast)

{And do not say to him who extends his greetings to you: You are not a believer. You seek the reward of the life of this world; for with God are many spoils. This is how you were before. So Allah has bestowed upon you, so investigate.} [An-Nisa: 94]
So he commanded them to become clear and steadfast in jihad, and not to say to someone whose condition is unknown:

You are not a believer. They seek to gain exposure to the life of this world, so telling them that he is not a believer is news without evidence, but rather based on their own desires. To take his money, even if that was in a place of war if he offered peace, and in the other reading (peace) then he might be a believer concealing his faith. Just as you were believers before, concealing your faith, so when a Muslim greets you and states that he is at peace with you and not a warrior, then stand firm. And find out, do not kill him and do not take his money until you discover his matter. Is he telling the truth or a liar? .

This is news that includes a claim for it, for the one who makes the claim is an informant, the one who denies is an informant, the witness is an informant, and the one who acknowledges is an informant, and just as he forbade them from Denying the accuser without knowledge forbade them from believing the accused denier, accusing the innocent without justification, and acquitting and recommending him without Knowledge, so God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book with the truth that you may judge between the people according to what God has shown you, and do not be an adversary to the traitors} [An-Nisa: 105] (105) {And ask forgiveness of God. Indeed, God is ever Forgiving, Most Merciful} [An-Nisa:

106] (106) {And do not argue on behalf of those who circumcise themselves. Indeed, God does not love one who is treacherous and sinful} [An-Nisa: 107] (107) {They hide from the people, and do not They hide from Allah, while He is with them when they express what He does not approve of in speech. And Allah is ever encompassing of what they do.} [An-Nisa: 108] (108) {Here you are. These are the people on whose behalf you argued in the life of this world. Who will argue on their behalf with God on the Day of Resurrection, or with the one who will be a guardian over them?} [An-Nisa: 109] (109) {And whoever does evil or wrongs himself and then seeks forgiveness from God will find God Forgiving, Merciful} [An-Nisa:

110] (110) {And whoever commits a sin, he only commits it against himself, and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise} [An-Nisa: 111] (111) And whoever {whoever commits a sin or A sin, then he accuses of it to an innocent person, for he has already committed a slander and a clear sin.} [An-Nisa: 112] (112) {And had it not been for the grace of God upon you and His mercy, a party would have been destroyed. Some of them are lest they lead you astray, but they lead astray none but themselves, and they do not harm you in any way. And God has sent down to you the Book and wisdom and taught you what you did not know. You know, and the grace of God upon you is great.} [An-Nisa: 113] And he also forbade them from believing the slanderer and the shooter who was known to be good, and said:
{Had it not been that when you heard it, the believing men and believing women thought good about themselves and said, “This is a clear deception.” [An-Nur: 12]

To his saying: {And had it not been for the grace of God upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, a great punishment would have afflicted you for that in which you have dispersed} [An-Nour: 14] (14) {When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge, and you thought it was easy, but in the sight of God it was great.} [An-Nour: 15] (15) {And had you not said, when you heard it, it is not for us that we speak of this. Glory be to You, this is a great slander} [An-Nour: 16] And the Almighty said: {And not You stop what you have no knowledge of.” [Al-Isra: 36]

This is a prohibition against speaking without knowledge, and it is general in all types of news, and it may cover what a person has been informed of, or what he has reported. He believes in something other than the information of evidence, verses, and signs. He has no right to speak without knowledge, so he should not deny anything except with knowledge, nor confirm it. Except with knowledge, and for this reason most scholars are of the opinion that the one who denies a thing is the evidence of what he denies, just as the one who affirms a thing is the evidence of it. It is proven, and it was reported on the authority of some people that he said:

The one who denies it has no evidence, and some of them differentiated between the rational and the Sharia, so they made it obligatory in the rational rather than the Sharia, and these people suspected it. It is upon them to deny the obstacle and demands. If someone proves something and someone else says to him: I do not know this, nor do I agree with you about it, nor will I hand it over to you until... You bring evidence. This was correct, and there was no evidence against this impediment to the demands of the evidence. Rather, the evidence is based on what is proven, unlike those who denied it. No one else confirmed it, and he said to him:

Your statement is wrong, and what is correct is the opposite of what you said, and this was not such-and-such, for this is evidence for its negation, as is evidence for that. Evidence to prove it, and if neither of them provides evidence, then both of them are without proof.
